tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i be'u bum gyi dkar chag gdams pa'i gnad kun gsal bar byed pa'i nyi 'od ces bya ba bzhugs so// rgya gar skad du/ kū la sarba pa ti bhaṭṭa ra ka badzra wa ra hi pā da ya na maḥ bod skad du/ rigs thams cad kyi bdag po rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /tshad med spros bral bden don mngon gzigs kyang / /grangs med rgyal kun bskyed pa'i yum mchog ma/ /dpag med mkha' spyod 'khrid pa'i lam mkhan mchog /mkha' spyod dbang dang dbyer med bla mar 'dud/ /gang gi sku ni rdul bral rā ga'i lhun po la/ /nyin byed 'bum gyis 'khyud pa'i gzi mdangs mngon par 'phro/ /dran pa'i mod la mkha' spyod go 'phang mchog stsol ba/ /yum chen mkha' spyod dbang mos rtag tu dge legs stsol/ /zab don rdo rje theg pa yi/ /nges don gzigs pa nā ro pa/ /dmigs med don mdzad pham mthing sogs/ /rgyud don gzigs rnams spyi bos mchod/ /bla med man ngag rgya mtsho las/ /nying khu yid nor gsang mtha'i lam/ /bod ljongs gsal mdzad 'jam pa'i dbyangs/ /dbang po'i grangs ldan spyi bos mchod/ /de lta'i bka' mchid zab don brgyud/ /snyan brgyud 'dzin pa chos kyi rje/ /blo gros rgyal mtshan brgyud par bcas/ /snying nas dran no brtse bas skyongs/ /gzhan yang rje btsun sa skya pa'i/ /'khrul med bstan pa spel mdzad pa'i/ /bstan 'dzin ngor rdzong gong dkar sogs/ /kun la phyag 'tshal byin gyis rlobs/ /khyad par rgyal ba'i dbang po yis/ /lung bstan brnyes pa e waṃ pa/ /rje btsun kun dga' bzang po yi/ /thugs rje'i zer gyis bdag la srungs/ /blo ldan mkhas grub kun gyi rgyan/ /gsal stong ting 'dzin mchog brnyes pas/ /rgya mtsho'i gos khyab gdul bya la/ /chos char 'bebs der phyag 'tshal lo/ /snyigs dus bstan pa'i nyi ma sngags 'chang rje/ /ngag gi dbang po kun dga' rin chen dang /

/de sras 'jam dbyangs sku mched rnam gnyis la/ /gus pas phyag 'tshal rjes su gzung du gsol/ /sngon tshe 'phags pa'i yul dang bod ljongs 'dir/ /mkhas grub du mar skye ba'i tshul bzung ba/ /sngags 'chang bla ma shes bya thams cad mkhyen/ /ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams spyi bos mchod/ /rdo rje snying po gos dkar 'dzin/ /'jam dbyangs bsod nams dbang phyug dang / /padma kā ra slar byon pa/ /kun dga' bkra shis rnam gnyis rgyal/ /khyod ni bgrang yas bskal pa'i sngon du yan lag bdun ldan brnyes zin yang / /slar yang ma dag gdul bya'i snang ngor sngags 'chang mchog gi zol 'chang ba/ /grub pa'i dbang phyug rtsa ba'i bla ma bsod nams rin chen grags pa'i dpal/ /rgyal ba'i ring lugs dus kun skyong la lan brgyar phyag 'tshal byin gyis rlobs/ /ma dag phung khams sa gzhi la/ /rnam dag sa bon 'debs mdzad pa'i/ /yongs dag grub dbang chos kyi rje/ /stobs kyi mgon po thar rtser 'dud/ /'jam pa'i dbyangs nyid ngur smrig 'dzin/ /'chad rtsod rtsom la zla bral ba'i/ /chos kyi spyan ldan gnas gsar rje/ /kun dga' legs pa'i zhabs la 'dud/ /rnam 'dren bdun pa rab gsal zla/ /mkhas grub du ma'i skur bstan nas/ /slar yang byon pa rdo rje 'chang / /bstan 'dzin rgya mtshor phyag 'tshal lo/ /gzhan yang mkha' spyod dbang mo yis/ /rjes bzung mkhas grub rgya mtsho'i tshogs/ /grangs dang tshad med thams cad la/ /sgo gsum dwang bas phyag 'tshal lo/ /don gnyis mthar phyin ston mchog dang / /sgrib gnyis mun sel dam pa'i chos/ /yon gnas dam pa dge 'dun te/ /dkon mchog rnam gsum spyi bos mchod/ /phyogs bcu'i zhing khams mu med par/ /rab dga' la sogs sar bzhugs pa'i/ /'jam dbyangs la sogs rgyal ba'i sras/ /ji snyed mchis pa thams cad rgyal/ /rgyal ba'i bstan pa rin po che/ /dus mthar skyong mdzad 'phags pa'i tshogs/ /dgra bcom gnas brtan bcu drug sogs/

/nyan thos rang sangs rgyas rnams mchod/ /bstan srung gtso bo ma hā kā la/ /bstan dgra'i srog 'phrog gdong bzhi pa/ /bstan 'dzin las sgrub pu tra sogs/ /bstan srung dam can rgya mtsho mchod/ /khyad par 'khor lo sdom pa yi/ /bstan srung zhal bzhes dpa' bo che/ /nor lha'i gtso bo zhing skyong zung / /sgrub la 'dod dgu'i dngos grub stsol/ /khams gsum dbang sdud rigs byed ma/ /sgrub pa'i dbul sel tshogs kyi bdag /dngos grub mchog stsol 'dod rgyal te/ /brtan g.yo dbang sdud rnam gsum mchod/ /de ltar mchod 'os rnams la gus btud nas/ /rmad byung rdo rje theg pa'i nying khu'i bcud/ /zab pa'i yang rtse nā ro mkha' spyod kyi/ /rab zab gdams pa'i be'u bum dkar chag 'bri/ /'di ni mthong ba tsam gyis man ngag gnad/ /kun kyang gsal bar byed pa'i nyi ma ste/ /des na gong gi ming kyang gdams pa'i gnad/ /kun gsal nyi 'od bdag gis 'bri bar bya/ /de la 'dir bdag cag gi ston pa thub pa'i dbang po de nyid kyis gdul bya'i bsams pa dang mthun par chos tshul bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhig gsungs pa rnams bsdu na theg pa che chung gnyis su 'dus pa las/ 'dir theg pa chen po/ de las kyang mdo sngags gnyis las 'dir gsang sngags kyi theg pa/ de la yang rgyud sde bzhi las 'dir rnal 'byor chen po/ rnal 'byor chen po la yang pha rgyud ma rgyud gnyis med kyi rgyud dang gsum du yod pa las/ 'di ma rgyud 'khor lo sdom pa'i rigs yin zhing / de la yang rtsa rgyud nag po'i skor/ kun spyod lū hi'i skor/ zab don dril bu'i skor/ zab pa'i yang rtse nā ro mkha' spyod rnams las/ 'dir phyi ma nyid 'chad par bya ba la gnyis te/ 'phags yul dang bod yul du byung tshul lo/ /dang po ni/ rgya gar 'phags pa'i yul gyi paṇa grub kun gyi gtsug rgyan dam pa jo bo nā ro ta pa de nyid kyis rnal 'byor gsang mtha'i nying khu rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma 'di nyid kyi lam bzang bla na med pa la brten nas grub pa brnyes pa'i tshul bzung ste/

'di skor gyi gdams pa zab mo rnams nyid kyi zhal slob phal che ba kun la ma gnang zhing / gnyis skyes dang mchog gnyis la sogs pa slob ma'i gtso bo paṇḍi ta bcu gcig tsam dang bod yul gyi lho brag mar pa lo tsā ba la sogs pa rgya bod kyi dka' ba du ma spyad pa'i grags chen gyi slob ma'i mchog de rnams la'ang ma gnang bar/ shin tu zab pa'i gdams pa 'di nyid bal po pham mthing pa sku mched gcen 'jigs med grags pa dang gcung dus 'khor ba gnyis la legs par bstsal zhing / de nyid gnyis pa bod yul du dar ba'i tshul ni/ pham mthing pa'i slob ma klog skya shes rab brtsegs dang mal lo tsā ba las rim par brgyud/ gangs ljongs bstan pa'i mnga' bdag rje btsun sa skya pa chen po kun dga' snying pos mal lo de nyid mnyes pa gsum gyi sgo nas mnyes par mdzad de legs par gsan cing bka' babs pa shin tu zab pa las kyang ches zab pa rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i chos skor 'di la rjes 'brangs bstan 'dzin gyi slob ma ngor rdzong gong dkar ba sogs du ma yod pa las ngor pa'i brgyud 'dzin rnams la byin rlabs dang nyams khrid lung rgyun sogs phal cher ma nyams par bzhugs shing rdzong chung pa rnams 'di skor la spros med kyi stabs byin rlabs dang man ngag phran tshegs las med cing / gong dkar ba rnams la'ang byin rlabs kyi rgyun tsam las med la/ thun mong ma yin pa rje btsun sa skya pa'i gong ma rdo rje 'chang rnams kyi zhal nas zhal dang snyan nas snyan du brgyud pa'i gdams pa zab mo kun gyi mdzod 'dzin pa ni tshar chen chos kyi rgyal po brgyud 'dzin dang bcas pa nyid yin te/ rje nyid kyi gsung las/ snyan brgyud rgya mtsho'i mnga' bdag rdo rje 'chang / /kun spangs chos rje'i zhal las thos gyur cing / /zhes gsungs pa ltar gyi snyan brgyud thun mong ma yin pa rje btsun nā ro mkha' spyod kyi man ngag zab mo rnams glegs bam du bzhengs te/

dkar chag tu 'bri ba la/ brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs kyi skor/ rgyud dang rgya gzhung sgrub thabs las tshogs dang / bod gzhung sgrub thabs kyi skor/ dkyil 'khor sgrub mchod kyi skor/ tshogs mchod kyi skor/ slob ma byin rlabs kyi skor/ rnam bshad kyi skor/ zin bris dang 'chad thabs kyi skor/ thun mong ba'i khrid kyi skor/ bsnyen thabs dang sbyin sreg gi skor/ thun mong ma yin pa'i 'khrid 'pho ba dang bcas pa'i skor/ mtha' rten smon lam dang bkra shis kyi skor te don tshan bcu gcig gi sgo nas 'chad pa la/ bla ma brgyud rim gyi gsol 'debs 'di dag thog ma nyid du 'byung ba'i rgyu mtshan ci yin snyam na/ gsang chen zab mo'i lam thams cad bla ma nyid la brten dgos pa yin te/ bdag nyid chen po sa paṇa gyis/ nyi ma'i 'od zer rab tsha yang / /me shel med par me mi 'byung / /de bzhin sangs rgyas byin rlabs kyang / /bla ma med par 'byung mi 'gyur/ /des na khyod nyid mnyes pa yis/ /sangs rgyas thams cad mnyes par 'gyur/ /zhes dang / dpal gsang ba 'dus pa las/ gang gi bskal pa bye ba ni/ /brgya phrag du yang rnyed dka' ba/ /de nyid sangs rgyas bcom ldan la/ /skye ba 'dir ni stsol bar mdzad/ /ces sogs rgya cher bka' bstsal pas na/ gsang chen zab mo 'di la rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma dam pa rnams mchod cing gsol ba 'debs pa nyid gtso che ba yin pas/ rgyu mtshan de'i phyir 'dir thog mar rje btsun nā ro mkha' spyod kyi bla ma brgyud pa la gsol ba 'debs par/ ༈ ngor chen rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang pos mdzad pa mgor oṃ swasti/ bsod nams ye shes tshogs gnyis rab rdzogs shing / /zhes dang / mjug tu/ 'gro ba'i bla ma bsod nams rgyal mtshan dpal/ /zhes bcug la bya'o/ /mkha' spyod man ngag gi bla ma brgyud rim la gsol ba 'debs pa shākya'i dge slong kun dga' bzang pos sbyar ba'o'i mtha' can/ ༈ yang de'i mjug tu de nyid kyis mdzad pa'i brgyud 'debs bsdus pa/

mgor/ rdo rje 'chang dang rdo rje rnal 'byor ma/ /zhes dang / mjug tu/ mkha' spyod go 'phang thob par byin gyis rlobs/ /zhes pa dge slong kun dka' bzang pos sbyar ba'o'i mtha' can/ ༈ de'i mjug tu kha skong mgor/ rdo rje 'chang chen kun dga' bzang po dang / /zhes pa shlau ka gcig gi mjug tu zhes kha bskangs so'i mtha' can/ ༈ yang mgor/ tshar chen chos rje 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang / /zhes sogs shlau ka gcig gi mjug tu zhes pa'ang bya bral bas sbyar ro'i mtha' can rnams sde tshan gcig ༈ yang rdo rje rnal 'byor ma la gsol 'debs mgor/ na mo mañdzu nā tha ya/ sku lnga lhun grub rdo rje 'chang / /zhes dang / mjug tu/ rnal 'byor ma dpal 'grub gyur cig /maṅga laṃ gyi mtha' can bla chen chos dpal gyis mdzad pa/ ༈ yang brgyud 'debs pad dkar bzhad pa'i dga' ston mgor/ na mo gu ru badzra wā ra hi/ rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i rigs bdag rdo rje chos/ /zhes dang / mjug tu/ rdo rje btsun mo'i zhabs kyis ring nas bskyangs pa'i rnal 'byor pa blo gsal gyis stod lung sa ra'i gzim khang gi yang thog me mtshams kyi ba gam bzhi par rakta bzhad pa'i phyogs kyi tshes la sbyar ba dge legs 'phel/ shu bhaṃ mastu sarba dza ga taṃ gyi mtha' can/ ༈ yang nā ro mkha' spyod kyi lam rim brgyud 'debs mgor/ rgyal ba kun yum rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i/ /zhes dang / mjug tu/ lam bzang 'di la dad pa'i bshes gnyen dag gis lan mang du bskul ba'i ngor dag pa mkha' spyod kyi rnal 'byor pa nā gardzu nas chu mo bya'i lo dpyid kyi zla ba la mdog ya ga chos sdings kyi gtsug lag khang du sbyar ba'o/ /shū bhaṃ mastu sarba dza ga taṃ gyi mtha' can/ ༈ yang nā ro mkha' spyod kyi brgyud 'debs mgor/ na mo badzra wā ra hi ye/ rdo rje 'chang dang rje btsun rnal 'byor ma/ /zhes dang / mjug tu/ za hor gyi ban dhes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni gnas ban 'jam dbyangs so/

/maṅga laṃ gyi mtha' can/ ༈ yang brgyud 'debs gnas sbyar ma byin rlabs chu shel dbang po kho bos sbyar ba mgor/ na mo gu ru badzra yo gi ni/ gnas rang bzhin lhun grub pho brang du/ /zhes dang / mjug tu/ gnas mkha' spyod bgrod par byin gyis rlobs/ /maṅga laṃ gyi mtha' can/ ༈ yang de rjes mgor/ na mo gu ru badzra wā ra hi/ gnas mkha' khyab zung 'jug gzhal yas su/ /zhes dang / mjug tu/ mkha' spyod mngon du 'gyur bar byin gyis rlobs shig sarba maṅga laṃ gyi mtha' can/ ༈ yang de rjes mgor/ na ma gu ru badzra wā ra hi/ rten dal 'byor mi rtag dran bskul gyi/ /zhes dang / mjug tu/ sa skya pa kun blos sbyar ba dge'i mtha' can/ ༈ yang nā ro mkha' spyod kyi brgyud 'debs lugs gnyis kyi kha skong rags rim phyogs gcig tu bsdoms nas kho bos sbyar ba mgor/ oṃ swasti/ rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang pos mdzad pa'i zhes dang / mjug tu/ dge legs 'phel gyi mtha' can rnams kyi dang po brgyud rim gsol 'debs kyi skor dang / ༈ gnyis pa rgyud dang rgya gzhung sgrub thabs las tshogs dang / bod gzhung sgrub thabs kyi skor la/ ༈ thog mar 'khor lo bde mchog gi rgyud nyung ngu le'u lnga bcu rtsa gcig pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po/ ka ra warma dang / lo chen rin chen bzang pos bsgyur ba la slar su ma ti kīrti dang mal los bsgyur ba/ nged rang gis brtsams pa'i glegs bam bzhengs byang brgyud 'debs bcas/ rgya gzhung la rtsa ba lta bur gyur pa jo bo nā ro ta pas mdzad pa'i sgrub thabs rgya gzhung mgor/ rgya gar skad du/ badzra yo gi ni swa dhā na/ bod skad du/ rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i sgrub thabs/ thugs rje chen po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dang po re zhig rnal 'byor pas/ /zhes dang / mjug tu/ dge slong pradzña kīrtis bsgyur cing gtan la phab pa'o'i mtha' can sa chen gyi gsung mchan dang bcas pa/ ༈ bod gzhung la thog mar sa chen gyis mdzad pa'i skor ni/

rgya gzhung de'i mjug tu sgrub thabs rnal 'byor bcu gcig phyi mchod mdor bsdus dang bcas pa/ mgor/ bla ma dam pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rdo rje rnal 'byor ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /thugs rje chen po spyan ras gzigs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i sgrub thabs la zhes dang / mjug tu/ de ltar don bcu gcig go'i mtha' can mchan bcas/ ༈ de rjes phyi mchod kyi mgor/ 'di'i phyi mchod mdor bsdus byed na zhes dang / mjug tu/ byang chub sems dpa' 'am dkrol ba'i mtha' can mchan can/ ༈ de rjes bskyed rim la brten nas mkha' spyod sgrub pa/ mgor/ rdo rje rnal 'byor ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bskyed pa'i rim pa'i cha bzlas bsgom rnal 'byor la brten nas/ mkha' spyod kyi dngos grub sgrub pa ni zhes dang / mjug tu/ bla ma dam pa'i zhal gyi gdams pa rdzogs so'i mtha' can mchan phran bu bcas/ ༈ de rjes byin rlabs kyi yi ge mgor/ dpal bde mchog 'khor lo la phyag 'tshal lo/ /tshes bcu la sogs dus khyad par can rnams kyi dus su zhes dang / mjug tu/ bu mo gzhon nu ma la ston mo bya ba dam tshig go'i mtha' can mchan bcas/ ༈ de rjes tshogs mchod mdor bsdus mgor/ rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /tshogs kyi mchod pa mdor bsdus byed par 'dod na/ zhes dang / mjug tu/ las kyi rjes mi mngon par bya'o'i mtha' can/ ༈ de rjes tshes bcu'i mchod pa mgor/ bla ma dam pa rnams dang rdo rje rnal 'byor ma tha mi dad pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rnal 'byor pa'i tshes bcu'i mchod pa yi dam du byed na zhes dang / mjug tu/ nyes pa thams cad 'dag gsungs pa'i mtha' can/ ༈ de rjes sbyin sreg gi mgor/ bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rnal 'byor ma'i sbyin sreg byed par 'dod pas zhes dang / mjug tu/ yang na bdag nyid la bsdu'i mtha' can mchan phran bcas/ ༈ de rjes mar me'i sbyin sreg mgor/

rdo rje rnal 'byor ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rnal 'byor pa gang zhig mar me'i sbyin sreg byed par 'dod na/ zhes dang / mjug tu/ yi ger bkod pa'i mtha' can mchan phran bcas/ ༈ de rjes lam gyi yan lag pra se na dbab pa/ mgor/ na mo gu ru bha dra ya lam gyi yan lag pra se na dbab pa'i gdams ngag ni/ zhes dang / mjug tu/ pra se na dbab pa'i man ngag go'i mtha' can/ ༈ de rjes gnod sbyin mo'i sgrub thabs rgyud kyi dum bu'i mgor/ de nas gnod sbyin mo'i rtogs pa bshad par bya ste/ gang zhig bsgrubs pas bskal par gnas par 'gyur ro/ /zhes dang / mjug tu/ de hi da ha sa ya swāhā'i mtha' can mchan bcas/ ༈ de rjes padma ti'i sgrub thabs mgor/ gnod sbyin mo'i bcud len dang / /dgos pa thams cad ster byed pa/ /zhes dang / mjug tu/ man ngag rdzogs so'i mtha' can mchan bcas/ ༈ de rjes pa ta na'i sgrub thabs mgor/ 'ong nges pa'i 'jigs pa ci byung yang / sngags rgyun ma bcad gsung zhes dang / mjug tu/ zhes brjod kyi mtha' can mchan gcig bcas/ ༈ de rjes sman chen po'i bcud len mgor/ oṃ swasti siddhaṃ/ bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo/ /bong nga cha gcig la ngan na a ru ra drug 'gyur/ bzang na bcu gnyis 'gyur bya zhes dang / mjug tu/ thun mong ma yin pa'i gdams ngag go'i mtha' can/ ༈ de rjes padma ti'i sgrub thabs zhal shes mgor/ rdo rje phag mo la phyag 'tshal lo/ /don grub ma yi dam du byed pa'i rten gyi gang zag gis/ zhes dang / mjug tu/ gdams ngag brgyud pa'i yig chung rdzogs so'i mtha' can/ mchan gsum bcas rnams sa chen gyis mdzad pa dang / yig rnying la sa chen gyis mchan mdzad pa/ ༈ de rjes sa chen gyi yi ge rnams kyi bsdus don brag phug pa'i gsung sgros mgor/ bla ma nā ro ta pa'i gdams ngag 'di skor la bzhi ste zhes dang / mjug tu/ byin rlabs kyi zhar la mkha' spyod sgrub pa cung zad kyang snang ngo /

/shu bhaṃ gyi mtha' can/ ༈ 'di gsham na yig chung rje sa chen gyi yi ge gong ma'i mchan bu dang bcas pa 'di nā ro mkha' spyod kyi yi ge'i snying po lta bu med mi rung du yod pas gces spras mchog tu bya'o/ /zhes tshar chen yab sras kyi phyag dpe las 'byung ngo / /zhes yod pa rnams sde tshan gcig dang / ༈ nā ro mkha' spyod kyi sgrub thabs 'phags pa rin po ches mdzad pa'i mgor/ dpal rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i sgrub thabs/ dpal rdo rje rnal 'byor ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyis/ /zhes dang / mjug tu/ sa mo sbrul gyi lo gdu bu zla ba la shangs mdor sbyar ba'o/ /shu bhaṃ mastu/ sarba dza ga taṃ gyi mtha' can/ ༈ yang des mdzad pa'i sgrub thabs chung ba mgor/ rdo rje rnal 'byor mkha' spyod ma bsgom par 'dod pas stan bde ba la 'dug ste/ zhes dang / mjug tu/ 'phags pas me pho byi ba'i lo zla ba gnyis pa'i tshes brgyad la sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni a tsā ra'o/ /maṅga laṃ gyi mtha' can/ ༈ yang rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i sgrub thabs mgor/ dpal rdo rje rnal 'byor ma sgrub pa'i thabs/ rdo rje rnal 'byor ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rgyal ba thams cad bskyed pa'i yum/ /zhes dang / mjug tu/ don la 'gal ba med pas shes par bya'o/ /maṅga laṃ gyi mtha' can/ ༈ rgya gar sher bzang gis mdzad pa/ de rjes des mdzad pa'i bdag 'jug mgor/ na mo gu ru bhyaḥ na mo buddha ḍā ki ni bhyaḥ mkha' 'gro sum cu rtsa drug la sogs pa/ /zhes dang / mjug tu/ don gnyer slob mas bskul ba'i ngor sbyar ba'o/ /maṅga laṃ gyi mtha' can/ ༈ yang ngor chen gyis mdzad pa'i rnal 'byor ma'i sgrub thabs mgor/ swasti/ nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad dus 'di nas bzung ste zhes dang / mjug tu/ gnas skabs thams cad du rje btsun ma'i nga rgyal gyis gnas par bya'o/ /maṅga laṃ bha wantu'i mtha' can mchan bcas/ ༈ yang mkha' spyod ma'i sgrub thabs mgor/

na mo gu ru badzra wā ra hi/ nā ro mkha' spyod kyi sgrub pa'i thabs nyams su len par byed pa la don bcu gcig ste/ zhes dang / mjug tu/ shākya'i dge slong kun dga' bzang pos sbyar ba'o/ /zhes pa la/ ā nan ta bha dras mdzad pa gzhi mor byas nas mchan bus gsal bar byas pa 'di ni nā ro pa'i rgya gzhung gi 'grel pa rje sa chen gyis mdzad pa'i rnal 'byor bcu gcig gi sgo nas gsal bar byas pa'i tshig don rnams dang / bla ma mkhas pa'i gsung sgros kyis brgyan te shākya'i dge slong mnga' ris tshul khrims 'od zer gyis zhes pa nas shākya rin chen gyis bris maṅga laṃ gyi mtha' can/ ༈ yang rnal 'byor bcu gcig bsgom tshul tshes bcu'i mchod pa sbyin sreg dang bcas pa kun mkhyen bsod nams seng ges mdzad pa mgor/ na mo badzra yo gi nī ye/ thugs rjes 'gro la rjes chags mdzes pa'i sku/ /zhes dang / mjug tu/ mkha' la spyod pa'i gnas su skye bar shog /maṅga laṃ bha wantu shu bhaṃ gyi mtha' can/ ༈ yang rnal 'byor ma'i sgrub thabs sangs rgyas dpal bzang gis mdzad pa'i mgor/ bla ma dam pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rje btsun rnal 'byor ma sgrub pa'i thabs la don bcu gcig gis nges par bya ste/ zhes dang / mjug tu/ dam tshig pa rang la bsdu'o/ /maṅga laṃ gyi mtha' can/ ༈ rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i sgrub thabs dgos 'dod 'byung ba sangs rgyas bzang pos mdzad pa mgor/ dus gsum rgyal ba'i mnga' bdag bla ma dang / zhes dang / mjug tu/ dbang bzhi'i bdud rtsi thob par shog gi mtha' can/ ༈ yang de rjes brgyud 'debs mgor/ rdo rje 'chang dang rdo rje rnal 'byor ma/ zhes dang / mjug tu/ gnyos kyis sug bris bgyis pa zhus dag dge'o'i mtha' can/ ༈ yang rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i rgyun gyi nyams len mgor/ bdag dang 'gro ba nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad ces dang / mjug tu/ dge bas mkha' spyod 'grub par shog

/shu bhaṃ gyi mtha' can sa los mdzad pa/ ༈ yang rnal 'byor bcu gcig nyams su len tshul mgor/ na mo gu ru ratna wārdha ya/ rnam kun mchog ldan shes rab lha mo dang / /zhes dang / mjug tu/ dkon mchog lhun grub kyis sbyar ba'o/ /shu bhaṃ gyi mtha' can/ ༈ yang mkha' spyod ma'i nyams len dang rtsa dbu ma'i dmigs rim mdor bsdus ngag dbang nyi zla bzang pos mdzad pa mgor/ oṃ swasti/ rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma bsgom par 'dod pas zhes dang / mjug tu/ 'gro kun rgyal yum go 'phang 'thob phyir bsngo'o/ /maṅga laṃ gyi mtha' can/ ༈ yang nā ro mkha' spyod kyi nyams len mgor/ na mo gu ru badzra yo gi nī ye/ 'dir rje btsun nā ro ta pas gzhan la ma gnang ba'i gdams pa zhes dang / mjug tu/ grub pa'i lung ltar bdag gis bkod/ ྀatsha'i mtha' can mdzad byang med pa/ ༈ yang nā ro mkha' spyod kyi nyams len blo gsal rgya mtshos mdzad pa mgor/ na mo gu ru badzra wā rā hi/ rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma nā ro mkha' spyod ma'i sgrub thabs rgyun du nyams su blang ba'i ngag 'don gyi tshul ni zhes dang / mjug tu/ ngag 'don bklags chog tu bkod pa'o/ /shu bhaṃ gyi mtha' can/ ༈ yang rgyun gyi nyams len mgor/ bdag dang 'gro ba nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad dus 'di nas bzung ste zhes dang / mjug tu/ sa los mdzad pa la kha 'phangs pa rnams sa skya pa ngag gi dbang po kun dga' rin chen gyis bcug pa yin/ sarba maṅga laṃ gyi mtha' can/ ༈ yang des mdzad pa'i sgrub thabs rgyas pa ma rig mun sel mgor/ na mo gu ru badzra yo gi ni bhyaḥ bla ma dang rdo rje rnal 'byor ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /stan bde ba la 'dug nas zhes dang / mjug tu/ nyes pa'i tshogs rnams bla ma dang chos srung la bshags so/ /sarba maṅga laṃ gyi mtha' can/ ༈ yang rgyun gyi nyams len bla ma'i rnal 'byor sogs tshar chen gyi gsung rgyun bzhin dbang phyug rab brtan gyis mdzad pa mgor/

na ma gu ru we/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed rdo rje sems dpa'i bsgom bzlas byas na/ zhes dang / mjug tu/ 'dis kyang rje bla ma'i slob bshad zab mo'i bstan pa dar zhing rgyas la yun ring du gnas par gyur cig shu bhaṃ gyis mtha' can/ ༈ yang sgrub thabs 'dod dgu'i char 'bebs mgor/ na mo gu ru badzra yo gi ni bhyaḥ bla ma dang rdo rje rnal 'byor ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /stan bde ba la 'dug nas zhes dang / mjug tu/ 'di la nyes pa'i tshogs mchis na bla ma dang chos srung la bshags so/ /sarba maṅga laṃ gyi mtha' can/ sa skya pa bsod nams dbang phyug gis mdzad pa rtsa sngags dang / yo ga shuddha'i sngags la mchan bcas/ ༈ yang des mdzad pa'i sgrub thabs rgyun gyi nyams len mgor/ na mo gu ru badzra wā rā hi/ rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma nā ro mkha' spyod ma'i sgrub thabs rgyun gyi nyams su blang ba'i ngag 'don nyams su len tshul ni/ zhes dang / mjug tu/ nyes pa'i tshogs rnams bla ma dang chos srung la bshags so/ /sarba maṅga laṃ gyi mtha' can/ ༈ yang rnal 'byor bcu gcig gi nyams len gyi gnad bsdus pa sa skya pa kun dga' bkra shis kyis mdzad pa mgor/ na mo gu ru/ rje btsun rnal 'byor ma'i nyams len ni/ rje sa chen gyi zhal nas zhes dang / mjug tu/ ngag dbang kun dga' bkra shis kyi blo mtsho las so/ /maṅga laṃ gyi mtha' can/ ༈ yang rgyun khyer rmor chen rdo rje 'chang gis mdzad pa mgor/ na mo gu ru we/ rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i mngon rtogs ngag 'don ni/ zhes dang / mjug tu/ bkra shis pa'i chos sder bris pa'o/ /sarba maṅga laṃ gyi mtha' can/ ༈ yang des mdzad pa'i sgrub thabs mgor/ na mo badzra wā rā hi/ bdag dang mkha' mnyam 'gro ba ma lus pa/ /zhes dang / mjug tu/ yi ge pa ni lhun grub 'jam dpal lo/ /maṅga laṃ gyi mtha' can/ ༈ yang des mdzad pa'i rnal 'byor bcu gcig gi nyams len snying po dril ba snyan brgyud gser gyi yang zhun snod min la gsang ba'i chos mgor/

na mo badzra wā rā hi/ khyab bdag gar gyi dbang phyug rdo rje chos/ /zhes dang / mjug tu/ bla ma'i bka' 'bangs lhun grub kyis dben gnas rmor dgon par bris pa'o'i mtha' can 'di sgrub thabs kyi gras su bkod kyang lung klog pa'i tshe thun mong ma yin pa rnams kyi gras la klog go/ ༈ yang sgrub thabs tshigs bcad bklags pas myur 'grub mgor/ na mo gu ru badzra wā rā hi/ rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma nā ro mkha' spyod ma'i bsgom bzlas nyams su len par 'dod pas/ dben pa'i gnas su bde ba'i stan la bsam gtan gyi rol pas kha nub tu phyogs shing skyabs yul gsal 'debs ni/ zhes dang / mjug tu/ dge des mkha' spyod go 'phang myur thob shog /oṃ su pra tiṣṭha badzra ye swāhā/ maṅga laṃ gyi mtha' can/ rdo rje 'chang gnas gsar chos kyi rje ngag dbang kun dga' legs pa'i 'byung gnas theg mchog bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos mdzad pa/ yig brgya la mchan bcas/ ༈ sgrub thabs mkha' spyod sgrub pa'i lam bzang mgor/ na mo gu ru badzra wā rā hi/ rgyal ba'i yum mchog rnal 'byor mar/ /gus btud nas ni de nyid kyi/ /zhes dang / mjug tu/ sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dga' blo gros kyi mgyogs par sbyar ba dge legs 'phel gyi mtha' can/ ༈ yang kho bos sbyar ba'i sgrub thabs dang 'pho ba lhan cig tu bkod pa 'chi med 'bras ster mgor/ na mo gu ru badzra wā rā hi/ rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma/ /zhes dang / mjug tu/ bsod nams 'od zer gyis bgyis/ sarba maṅga laṃ gyi mtha' can rnams kyis sgrub thabs skor rdzogs nas/ ༈ gsum pa dkyil 'khor sgrub mchod dang bdag 'jug gi skor la/ thog mar/ nā ro mkha' spyod kyi bdag 'jug 'phags pa rin po ches mdzad pa mgor/ dpal rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i sindhu ra yi dkyil 'khor du bdag nyid 'jug cing dbang blang ba'i cho ga ces dang / mjug tu/ shangs mdo'i gtsug lag khang du sbyar ba'o/

/shu bhaṃ gyi mtha' can/ ༈ yang des mdzad pa'i bdag 'jug sdom tshig mgor/ bgegs bskrad zhu 'bul tshom rngam bsrungs/ /zhes dang / mjug tu/ gtor ma nang mchod bum pa bshams/ shu bhaṃ gyi mtha' mchan phran bcas/ ༈ yang ngor chen gyis mdzad pa'i mngon dkyil mgor/ oṃ swasti siddhaṃ/ bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes dang / mjug tu/ zin bris yin pa la rgyu mtshan med do/ /maṅga laṃ gyi mtha' can/ 'di'i khongs su slob ma rjes 'dzin sbyin sreg gnyis/ tshes bcu'i mchod pa/ bzlas bsgom la brten nas mkha' spyod pa'i thabs rnams ngor chen gyi gsung bzhin zhal slob zhig gis bsgrigs 'dra snyam pa/ ༈ de'i yan lag lta bur ngor chen gyis mdzad pa'i bstod pa yan lag bdun ldan mgor/ na maḥshrī badzra yo gi ni ye/ ye shes chen po'i mdzod 'dzin chos kyi rje/ /zhes dang / mjug tu/ mkhas pa'i chos grwa dpal ldan sa skyar bris/ /shu bhaṃ gyi mtha' can/ ༈ yang rje btsun nā ro mkha' spyod kyi chos skor phyogs gcig tu bsdebs pa man ngag rin po che'i gter sngags 'chang gzungs dpal bas mdzad pa mgor/ oṃ swasti siddhaṃ/ bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /ma lus 'gro ba'i sems la khyab pa rjes 'gro zhing / /zhes dang / mjug tu/ rig pa 'dzin pa gzungs kyi dpal bzang pos lug gi lo sa ga zla ba'i yar tshes bcu'i nyin dpal ldan sa skyar sbyar ba'o/ /dge legs su gyur cig 'dis 'gro ba dpag tu med pa la phan thogs par gyur cig sarba maṅga laṃ/ shu bhaṃ gyi mtha' can/ ༈ sgrub mchod zur 'debs dngos grub rgya mtsho nam mkha' dbang phyug gis mdzad pa mgor/ na mo gu ru badzra yo gi ni na maḥ rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma sgrub cing mchod pa'i zhes dang / mjug tu dgon par 'bad de bris pa'o/ /'di bris dge bas sems can thams cad rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor mas rjes su 'dzin par gyur cig

maṅga laṃ/ shu bhaṃ gyi mtha' can/ ༈ yang sgrub mchod sogs kyi ngag 'don mgor/ oṃ swasti/ rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma sgrub cing mchod pa'i ngag 'don gsal ba ni/ zhes dang / mjug tu/ skal bzang dag sgom sgrub la 'bungs shig maṅga laṃ gyi mtha' can rje grol mchog gi mdzad pa/ ༈ yang sindhu ra yi dkyil 'khor sgrub mchod mkha' spyod sgrub pa'i nye lam mgor/ oṃ bde legs su gyur cig rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma nā ro mkha' spyod kyi sindhū ra'i dkyil 'khor sgrub cing mchod pa dang / zhes dang / mjug tu/ rje btsun rdo ring pa kun spangs chen po'i zhabs kyi padmo spyi bos mchod pa'i rnal 'byor pa blo gsal gyis 'u yug grub pa'i gnas kyi gtsug lag khang du bkod pa 'dis kyang bstan pa rin po che phyogs dus thams cad du dar zhing rgyas la yun ring du gnas par gyur cig yi ge pa ni rje btsun bla ma de nyid kyi bran du gyur pa btsun pa mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug gis bgyis pa'o/ /i daṃ shā sa nañtsa sarba satwa hi to bha wantu'i mtha' can/ ༈ de'i zhabs 'degs tshul du rdo rje rnal 'byor ma la snying nas gsol ba 'debs pa mgor/ rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rigs brgya 'khor lo'i mgon po lhag pa'i lha/ /zhes dang / /mjug tu/ rje btsun ma 'di la yi dam du byed pa'i rnal 'byor pa klu sgrub ces bgyi bas dpal mnyan yod bya rgod gshongs chos kyi skyed tshal yangs pa nas bsrings pa dge zhing bkra shis kyi mtha' can/ ༈ yang bdag 'jug mgor/ na mo gu ru buddha singha ya/ rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i bsnyen pa mthar phyin pa'i gang zag gis dngos grub don du gnyer bas/ zhes dang / mjug tu/ dge slong nam mkha' dpal bzang gis sbyar ba'o/ /maṅga laṃ gyi mtha' can/ ༈ yang sgrub mchod dang bdag nyid 'jug cing dbang blang ba 'gro kun mkha' spyod bgrod pa'i myur lam mgor/

na mo gu ru buddha dhwa dza badzra warṇaṇa nī ye/ bla ma rje btsun mus pa chen po dang gnyis su med pa'i rdo rje rnal 'byor ma la gus pas phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su mchi'o/ /byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ rje btsun bla ma mchog dang dbyer med pa'i/ /zhes dang / mjug tu/ ces kyang gdams te rgyu mtshan spros pas chog go /sarba maṅga laṃ gyi mtha' can/ ༈ rdo rje 'chang sa skya pa kun dga' bsod nams kyis mdzad pa mchan bcas kyi mjug tu glo bo mkhan chen gyis mdzad pa'i bkra shis mgor/ shrī tsakra saṃ bha ra ye/ bkra shis gang zhig chos kyi dbyings las legs byung ba/ /zhes dang / mjug tu dad pa'i dbang gis sa skya pa sngags 'chang kun dga' bsod nams kyi lag tu byung ba las zhal bshus dag par bgyis/ 'dis 'phral dang yun tu bkra shis dang dge legs kyi dpal 'bar bar gyur cig sarba maṅga laṃ gyi mtha' can/ ༈ yang sgrub dkyil mkha' spyod sgrub pa'i legs lam mgor/ oṃ bde legs su gyur cig rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i sindhu ra'i dkyil 'khor sgrub cing mchod pa dang / zhes dang / mjug tu/ /blo dman mun pa bsal phyir du/ /sngags 'chang bsod nams dbang phyug gis/ /gzhi thog pho brang yang stengs su/ /sbyar bas rang gzhan don grub shog /sarba maṅga laṃ gyi mtha' can/ ༈ yang bstod pa sangs rgyas phun tshogs kyis mdzad pa'i mgor/ na mo gu ru badzra yo gi nī ye/ dus gsum rgyal ba thams cad bskyed pa'i yum/ /zhes dang / mjug tu/ e waṃ chos ldan du bris pa'o/ /maṅga laṃ gyi mtha' can/ ༈ yang rmor chen rdo rje 'chang gis mdzad pa'i bstod pa mgor/ oṃ swa sti/ ma lus rgyal ba bskyed pa'i yum mchog ma/ /zhes dang / mjug tu/ dben gnas rmor gyi dgon par bris pa'o/ /sarba maṅga laṃ gyi mtha' can/ ༈ yang des mdzad pa'i zhing bkod mkha' spyod sgrub pa'i them skas mgor/ oṃ swa sti/ sras bcas rgyal ba kun gyis rab bsngags pa'i/

/zhes dang / mjug tu/ 'dis kyang sems can dpag tu med pa'i don byed par gyur cig bkra shis kyi mtha' can/ ༈ yang sgrub mchod dang tshes bcu'i dus su mchod phreng rgyas par bya tshul bsod nams rgyas byed mgor/ na mo gu ru badzra yo gi nī ye/ rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma nā ro mkha' spyod ma'i tshes bcu la sogs pa'i dus su spros pa la dga' bas mchod phreng rgyas par bya tshul ni/ zhes dang / mjug tu/ mkha' spyod sgrub pa'i nye lam gyi/ /lhan thabs tshul du bkod pa 'di/ /shākya'i btsun pa lhun grub kyis/ /gzhan phan phyir du bkod pa dge'i mtha' can/ ༈ yang des mdzad pa'i gshin po rjes 'dzin thar lam 'dren pa'i lcags kyu mgor/ oṃ swasti/ bla ma mchog dang dbyer med lhag pa'i lhar/ /zhes dang / mjug tu/ thar lam bgrod pa'i rgyur gyur cig /maṅga laṃ gyi mtha' can/ ༈ yang des mdzad pa'i sa chog mgor/ bla ma dang rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma gnyis su med pa la gus pas phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su mchi'o/ /byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes dang / mjug tu/ rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i sindhu ra'i cho gar mi gsal ba rnams kyi gsal byed tho chung 'di ni bya bral maṅga las bris pa'o/ /sarba maṅga laṃ bha wantu'i mtha' can mkhan chen bkra shis lhun grub kyis mdzad pa/ ༈ yang chog khrigs dpal ldan seng ges mdzad pa mgor/ he ru ka dpal bla ma la/ /phyag 'tshal gus pas zhabs pad 'dud/ /ces dang / mjug tu/ dge ba byang chub chen por bsngo/ /maṅga laṃ bha wantu'i mtha' can/ ༈ dus mtha'i cho ga dge legs 'bar ba'i 'od can kho bos sbyar ba mgor/ na ma gu ru badzra wā rā hi/ rgyal ba rgya mtsho bskyed dang sbyor ba'i yum/ /zhes dang / mjug tu/ bsod nams 'od zer gyis bgyis so/ /shu bhaṃ gyi mtha' can/ ༈ yang de la nyer mkho'i sa chog kho bos sbyar ba mgor/ swasti/ mkha' spyod ma yi sa chog ni/ zhes dang /

mjug tu/ blo gros go yangs kyis shes par bya'o'i mtha' can/ de rnams kyis dkyil 'khor sgrub mchod gyi skor rdzogs nas/ ༈ bzhi pa tshogs mchod kyi skor la/ ༈ thog mar/ nā ro mkha' spyod kyi tshogs mchod 'phags pas mdzad pa mgor/ dpal rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i tshogs kyi 'khor lo'i cho ga bla ma dang rdo rje rnal 'byor ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes dang / mjug tu/ lcags pho rta'i lo gdu bu zla ba'i tshes gcig la shangs mdor bris pa'o/ /dge'o'i mtha' can/ ༈ yang tshogs mchod nyung ngu rnam gsal mgor/ oṃ swasti/ bla ma mchog dang rje btsun rnal 'byor mar/ /zhes dang / dpal ldan rmor gyis rang gi bsam gtan khang bur sbyar ba'o/ /shu bhaṃ/ 'di dag gi rgyu dang mtha' dpyod lag len rgyas par gong ma'i yi ge rnams las rtogs par bya'o'i mtha' can/ rmor chen rdo rje 'chang gis mdzad pa mchan phran bcas pa/ ༈ tshogs mchod zab don nying khu kho bos sbyar ba mgor/ na mo gu ru badzra wā rā hi/ skyabs gnas kun 'dus mkha' spyod dbang mo dang / /zhes dang / mjug tu/ rgyur gyur cig maṅga laṃ gyi mtha' can/ ༈ yang de rjes mgor/ dpal kyai rdo rje'i rtsa ba'i rgyud brtag pa gnyis pa nas 'byung ba'i zhes dang / mjug tu/ dgongs 'jags zhu sarba maṅga laṃ gyi mtha' can rnams kyis tshogs mchod kyi skor rdzogs nas/ ༈ lnga pa byin rlabs bya tshul gyi skor la/ nā ro mkha' spyod kyi byin rlabs bya tshul mgor/ na mo gu ru we/ rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i sgo nas gzhan rjes su 'dzin pa la/ zhes dang / mjug tu/ rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po yab sras kyi gsung sgros la brten nas shākya'i dge slong mnga' ris rab 'byams pa tshul khrims 'od zer gyis rang gi brjed byang dang / las dang po pa rnams la phan pa'i ched du yi ger bkod pa dge legs 'phel gyi mtha' can/ ༈ yang byin rlabs bya tshul mgor/ 'dir nā ro mkha' spyod kyi byin rlabs bya tshul ni/

zhes dang / mjug tu/ deng nas brtsams te bdag bran sogs kyi bya ba rnams bya'o/ /'di yang gung rus bris pa'o/ /dge zhing bkra shis so'i mtha' can/ ༈ yang des mdzad pa'i byin rlabs bya tshul mgor/ phyag 'tshal bla ma rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma/ /zhes dang / mjug tu/ pradzña bha dras brjed byang du bris pa'o/ /maṅga laṃ gyi mtha' can mchan bcas/ ༈ yang byin brlabs sangs rgyas dpal bzang gis mdzad pa mgor/ na mo gu ru/ ye shes mkha' 'gro ma lus pa'i/ /zhes dang / mjug tu/ byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ sa ma pa thā/ maṅga laṃ gyi mtha' can/ ༈ yang byin rlabs bya tshul mgor/ na mo gu ru badzra yo gi ḍā ki ni bhyaḥ bla ma dang rje btsun rnal 'byor ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /kun khyab 'khor lo'i mgon po chos kyi rje/ /zhes dang / mjug tu/ zhi ba zhes pa sa mo bya'i lo nag pa zla ba'i dmar cha'i mkha' 'gro 'du ba'i dus khyad par can tshes bcu'i nyin gzhi thog bla brang chen po'i yang steng 'od gsal khor yug phug tu sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni blo gros rab tu gsal ba'i btsun pa ngag dbang dpal 'byor can gyis so/ /shu bhaṃ mastu sarba dza ga taṃ gyi mtha' can/ sngags 'chang kun dga' rin chen gyis mdzad pa/ ༈ yang byin brlabs kyi tho mgor/ sems can thams cad kyi don du zung 'jug rdo rje 'chang gi go 'phang thob par bya/ zhes dang / mjug tu/ g.yon pa'i srin lag gis me long gi sindhu ra'i mtha' can klu sgrub kyi rtsom 'phro/ ༈ yang byin rlabs bya tshul mthong ba don ldan thar rtse nam mkha' dpal bzang gis mdzad pa mgor/ na mo gu ru buddha singha ya/ bla ma yi dam dbyer med dang / /rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i/ /zhes dang / mjug tu/ brang ti pa dge slong nam mkha' dpal bzang gis e waṃ thar rtser sbyar ba'o/ /'dis kyang bstan pa dang sems can la phan thogs par gyur cig sarba maṅga laṃ bha wantu'i mtha' can/ ༈ yang byin brlab bya tshul 'gro kun mkha' spyod bgrod pa'i nye lam mgor/

na mo gu ru buddha dhwa dza ya/ bka' drin mnyam med mus pa chen po dang / /mkha' spyod dbang mo'i zhabs la gus btud nas/ /zhes dang / mjug tu/ mkha' spyod dge ba'i zhing du 'dren gyur cig /ces pa'i yi ge pa ni rang dang nye bar gnas pa'i dge slong rdo rje 'dzin pa byams pa dpal 'byor gyis gus spro'i sgo nas legs par bgyis so/ /kā lye na wardhan tu sarba maṅga laṃ gyi mtha' can/ sa chen bla ma rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bsod nams kyis mdzad pa de rnams kyis byin rlabs kyi skor rdzogs nas/ ༈ drug pa rnam bshad kyi skor la/ thog mar mkha' spyod ma sogs ma rgyud kyi lha bzhengs bsgom la phan pa'i tho tshe mgor/ na mo gu ru badzra wā rā hi/ deng sang dad ldan 'byor pa can/ /lha bzhengs mkhan 'ga' re 'dug kyang / /zhes dang / mjug tu/ 'di yang mkha' spyod ma bzhengs tshul du shel grong phreng kha bas mkha' spyod ma'i sku bzhengs tshar nas gzigs 'bul zhus pa de dus gung rus bris pa'o/ /shu bhaṃ gyi mtha' can/ ༈ yang nā ro mkha' spyod kyi rnam bshad rje nyi zla seng ges mdzad pa mgor/ bla ma dam pa rnams la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo/ /dpal bde mchog rtsa ba'i rgyud du zhes dang / mjug tu/ mkha' spyod go 'phang thob par gyur cig shū bhaṃ gyi mtha' can mchan phran bcas/ ༈ yang rnam bshad byams pa chos legs kyis mdzad pa mgor/ rje btsun bla ma thugs rje chen po dang ldan pa'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dus gsum rgyal ba ma lus bskyed pa'i yum/ /zhes dang / mjug tu/ 'di bris dge bas sems can thams cad kyis rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i go 'phang myur du thob par gyur cig maṅga laṃ bha wantu'i mtha' can/ ༈ yang rnal 'byor bcu gcig gi rnam bshad dngos grub myur 'gugs nyi zla bzang pos mdzad pa mgor/ 'jam mgon gnyis med grub pa'i dpa' bo che/ /zhes dang / mjug tu/ bde chen chos 'khor gyi skyed tshal du nye bar sbyar ba'o/

/shu bhaṃ mastu sarba dza ga taṃ gyi mtha' can/ ༈ yang bskyed rdzogs kyi rnam bshad mkha' spyod sgo 'byed buddha dhwa dzas mdzad pa mgor/ mkha' 'gro grangs med bsam gyis mi khyab na'ang / /de nyid dbye ba phyed dang bzhis bsdus/ /zhes dang / mjug tu/ gsang mtha'i smin grol lam la rab zhugs te/ /bcu gsum rdo rje 'dzin pa'i sa thob shog /maṅga laṃ gyi mtha' can/ ༈ yang rnal 'byor bcu gcig gi rnam bshad mkha' spyod lam bzang gsal ba'i nyin byed mgor/ na ma gu ru buddha dhwa dza ya/ rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i bskyed rim rnal 'byor bcu gcig gi rnam par bshad pa mkha' spyod lam bzang gsal ba'i nyin byed ces bya ba/ bla ma dang gnyis su med pa'i dpal mkha' spyod dbang mo la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes dang / mjug tu/ 'dis bstan pa rin po che dang sems can rnams la mchog tu phan par gyur cig shu bhaṃ mastu sarba dza ga taṃ sarba maṅga laṃ gyi mtha' can/ sa chen rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bsod nams kyis mdzad pa/ ༈ yang sgrub thabs kyi rnam bshad mkha' spyod lam bzang mgor/ oṃ swasti/ rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma nā ro mkha' spyod kyi sgrub thabs kyi rnam par bshad pa mkha' spyod lam bzang zhes bya ba rje btsun bla ma dam pa brgyud pa dang bcas pa rnams kyi zhabs la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes dang / mjug tu/ hūm̐ aṃ/ dpe 'di rnal 'byor ma'i byin rlabs ma thob pa rnams la bstan du mi rung zhing shin tu gsang bar bya'o/ /shu bhaṃ mastu sarba dza ga taṃ gyi mtha' can/ mchan cung zad bcas 'jam mgon sangs rgyas phun tshogs kyis mdzad pa/ ༈ yang rnam bshad chung ngu mgor/ bskyed pa'i rim pa'i cha zhes dang / mjug tu/ snying po gnyis kyi bar du baṃ yig la rang gi rnam par shes pa'i ngo bo yin bkra shis/ shin tu zab pa gda'o/ /e waṃ gyi mtha' can mdzad byang med pa/ ༈ yang brgyud 'debs 'dod gsol dang smon lam gyi don 'grel snyan brgyud bdud rtsi'i nying khu mgor/

na maḥgu ru wā rā hi ye/ bla ma dang rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma gnyis su med pa'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /skyabs gnas kun 'dus drin can rdo rje 'chang / /zhes dang / mjug tu/ thub bstan rdo rje brag gi chos smra ba dge slong bya bral ba padma 'phrin las kyis sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni dge slong sman mchog gis bgyis pa dza yan tu/ maṅga laṃ gyi mtha' can/ de rnams kyis rnam bshad kyi skor rdzogs nas/ ༈ bdun pa zin bris dang 'chad thabs kyis skor la/ thog mar/ ༈ nā ro mkha' spyod kyi bskyed rdzogs kyi zin bris bzang dpal gyis brjed byang du byas pa mgor/ mkha' 'gro grangs med stong phrag bdun cu gnyis/ /brtson chen la sogs nyi shu bzhis bsdus la/ /zhes dang / mjug tu/ de ltar bskyed rdzogs zin bris 'di/ /bzang dpal bdag gi brjed byang lags/ /shu bhaṃ gyi mtha' can/ ༈ yang sgrub thabs kyi bshad pa zin bris mgor/ bla ma dang rje btsun rnal 'byor ma dbyer med pa'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i lam gyi rim pa bcu gcig bshad na/ zhes dang / mjug tu/ ces pa 'di byams pa chos mchog pas mdzad pa'o/ /maṅga laṃ gyi mtha' can/ ༈ yang de'i mjug tu tshes bcu'i zur 'debs mgor/ bla ma dang rdo rje rnal 'byor ma gnyis su med pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gong rnam bshad du mi gsal ba rnams bla ma'i gsung las zin bris su btab pa ni/ zhes dang / mjug tu/ ma go ba nor ba yod pa rnams mkhas pas bcos mdzad par rigs so/ /sarba maṅga laṃ gyi mtha' can/ sngags 'chang kun dga' rin chen gyis mdzad pa/ ༈ yang bskyed rdzogs kyi rim pa tshar chen rdo rje 'chang gi gsung rgyun dge slong ring mo ba'i zin bris mgor/ bla ma mchog dang rje btsun rnal 'byor ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rje btsun rnal 'byor ma'i khrid kyi rim pa bsgom par 'dod pas zhes dang / mjug tu/ lam 'dis cha lag phal mo che thos pa'i dge slong ring mo bas yid la zin pa'i gsung rgyun khag che ba 'ga' zhig brjed thor btab pa'o/

/shu bhaṃ gyi mtha' can/ ༈ yang byin rlabs kyi zin bris mgor/ pha bla ma bsod nams chos 'phel gyi zhabs drung du rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma nā ro mkha' spyod ma'i byin rlabs gnang dus/ zhes dang / mjug tu/ dbang bzhi'i ngo sprod gang rgyas sogs dkyus bzhin mdzad do/ /shu bhaṃ mastu sarba dza ga taṃ gyi mtha' can/ ngag dbang chos grags kyis mdzad pa/ ༈ yang khrid rim bla ma'i gsung sgros dngos grub myur mgyogs kyi pho nya ngag dbang chos grags kyis zin bris su mdzad pa mgor/ bla ma dang rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma dbyer ma mchis pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'dir gang bshad par bya ba'i chos ni/ zhes dang / mjug tu/ bka' 'bangs kyi tha chung ngag dbang chos grags kyis zin bris su byas pa ྀatsha/ 'dis kyang rje bla ma dam pa'i bstan pa yul dus kun tu dar zhing rgyas par gyur cig shu bhaṃ gyi mtha' can/ ༈ yang de'i gsham na 'pho ba'i zhal shes zin bris gong gi mdzad pa pos mdzad pa mgor/ bla ma dang rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'dir 'pho ba'i zhal shes dang po ni/ zhes dang / mjug tu/ ngag dbang chos grags kyis zin bris su byas pa'o/ /shu bhaṃ gyi mtha' can/ ༈ yang de rjes des mdzad pa'i bsam mi khyab thun mong ma yin pa'i zhal shes zin bris mgor/ bla ma dang rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma dbyer ma mchis pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'dir bsam mi khyab thun mong ma yin pa'i zhal shes ni/ zhes dang / mjug tu/ ngag dbang chos grags kyis zin bris su byas pa ྀatsha/ shu bhaṃ mastu sarba dza ga taṃ gyi mtha' can rnams sde tshan gcig dang / ༈ yang bskyed rim nā ro mkha' spyod kyi zin bris snying gi gdung sel mgor/ rgyal ba'i yum mchog rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i/ /zhal bcud bdud rtsi'i rgya mtshor mnga' bsgyur ba/ /zhes dang / mjug tu/ rang sems mkha' spyod dbang mo'i 'dzum zhal mthong /

/rdzong ri pa nga dal 'byor don yod snyam/ /bkra shis kyi mtha' can mchan gcig bcas/ mang thos klu sgrub kyi slob ma byang pa rab 'byams pas zin bris su mdzad pa la slar mang thos byams pa bzang pos nyams bshus su bris pa/ ༈ yang bskyed rim rnal 'byor bcu gcig gi rnam bshad zin bris mgor/ gu ru badzra ḍā ki nā maḥ bde chen chos sku'i ngang las ma g.yos kyang / /mtha' yas sems can drang ba'i don slad du/ /zhes dang / mjug tu/ mdor na spyod lam rnam bzhi thams cad du/ /dga' ba gsum gyis dus 'da' bar bya'o/ /maṅga laṃ gyi mtha' can klu sgrub kyis mdzad 'dra ba/ ༈ yang nā ro mkha' spyod kyi mngon rtogs la brten nas sbyang gzhi sbyong tshul gyi man ngag shin tu zab pa mkhyen rab rje'i gsung las byung ba mgor/ na mo gu ru badzra yo gi ni bhyaḥ sku gsum lam du byed pa'i man ngag rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i mngon rtogs la brten nas lam nyams su blang bar bya ba la/ zhes dang / mjug tu/ mkhyen rab chos rje'i zhal las byung ba'i gdams pa yi ger bkod pa'o/ /dge'o'i mtha' can/ rmor chen gyis mdzad pa 'dra snyam pa/ ༈ yang rnal 'byor bcu gcig 'chad thabs mgor/ rtsa dbu ma'i 'khrid la/ gang gis 'khrid na rdo rje slob dpon mtshan nyid dang ldan pas 'khrid/ ces dang / mjug tu/ 'a zhwa'i bande theg pa mchog gi rnal 'byor pa dbang gi ming gis legs par bgyis pas slob bshad zab mo'i bstan pa dar zhing rgyas la yun ring du gnas par gyur cig shu bhaṃ mastu sarba dza ga taṃ gyi mtha' can/ ༈ nyer mkho bris pa mthong ba 'dzum shor sangs rgyas phun tshogs kyis mdzad pa mgor/ na mo gu ru we/ rgyal chen ind+ra bo dhi nas brgyud pa zhes dang / mjug tu/ brdzus skyes sbyong bar 'chad do'i mtha' can/ ༈ yang des mdzad pa'i sngags don mgor/ oṃ swasti/ rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i/ /zhes dang / mjug tu/ nye bar bsdus pa zhig bris nas phul bas zhu saṃ/

maṅga laṃ gyi mtha' can/ de rnams kyis zin bris dang 'chad thabs kyi skor rdzogs nas/ ༈ brgyad pa thun mong ba'i 'khrid kyi skor la/ ༈ thog mar phyi khrid mkha' spyod dga' ma'i nye lam gyi mgor/ oṃ na maḥshrī badzra gu ra we/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ngo bo rje btsun bla ma rdo rje 'chang blo gsal rgya mtsho grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po sku drin mtshungs pa ma mchis pa'i zhal snga nas kyi zhabs kyi pad mo la dus thams cad du phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su mchi'o/ /byin gyis brlab tu gsol zhes dang / mjug tu/ de skad 'a zhwa'i rigs kyi sdom bu ba/ /dpal ldan skal bzang dbang po mkhyen brtse'i ming / /rje btsun bla ma'i bran des yi ger bkod/ /dge bas bla ma'i bstan pa rgyas gyur cig /'dis kyang slob bshad zab mo'i bstan pa phyogs bcur dar zhing rgyas gyur cig shu bhaṃ gyi mtha' can/ phyag chen dbu mar 'jug pa'i yi ge mgor/ na mo nā ro ta pa/ phyag rgya chen po dbu mar 'jug pa la zhes dang / mjug tu/ 'od gsal mngon du gyur pa ni phyag rgya chen po dbu mar zhugs pa'o/ /shu bhaṃ gyi mtha' can/ sa chen gyis mdzad 'dra snyam/ ༈ yang zin bris snying gi gdung sel las bskyed rim gyi 'khrid yig dang bcas pa zhar las byung bas rdzogs rim gyi 'khrid yig mgor/ mkha' 'gro bye ba'i zhal bcud bdud rtsi yi/ /rgya mtshor 'phyur la ma nor longs spyod bzhin/ /zhes dang / mjug tu/ rnam dpyod blo gros rgyas pa'i bzhin rab gsal/ /byams rgyan nga la bla ma'i byin rlabs zhugs kyi mtha' can byang pa rab 'byams pas mdzad pa/ ༈ yang 'khrid yig bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun skal bzang snying gi gdung sel mgor/ zab lam mang po'i man ngag thob pa'i dpal/ /zab don bcud 'thung klu sgrub dbang po bzhin/ /zhes dang / mjug tu/ bla ma'i gsung bzhin snyoms las 'dzin pa gdong dga' rab 'byams pa 'jam dbyangs smra ba'i rgya mtshos tshe gcig gi nyams len hril bsdus nas bris pa dge zhing /

shing mo bya lo'i yar tshes bzhi'i chos 'khor bskor ba'i dus chen gyi nyin grub pas ma gyur sems can thams cad mkha' spyod chen po'i gnas su da lta nyid du 'khrid par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ maṅga laṃ gyi mtha' can/ ༈ yang rnal 'byor bcu'i nyams len la sgro 'dogs gcod pa dang sems 'dzin zung 'brel du gtong tshul mthong grol lde mig mgor/ swasti siddhaṃ/ mkha' spyod zhing gi rdo rje btsun mo yi/ /nye lam nā ro ta pa'i thugs kyi bcud/ /ces dang / mjug tu/ za hor gyi bandes lcags phag hor zla gnyis pa'i yar tshes bco lnga'i nyin sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni rigs byed pa ngag dbang nam mkha'o/ /shu bhaṃ gyi mtha' can/ de rnams kyis thun mong gi 'khrid kyi skor rdzogs nas/ ༈ dgu pa bsnyen thabs dang sbyin sreg gi skor la/ thog mar/ nā ro mkha' spyod ma'i bsnyen thabs mgor/ na mo gu ru ratna ya/ 'jam mgon grub dbang mkhas mchog brgyud par bcas/ /'jam dbyangs ma he'i zhal dngos ngag dbang rje/ /zhes dang / mjug tu/ e waṃ rgyud sde'i pho brang du bla ma'i bran du gyur pa ngag dbang chos grags kyis bris pa'o/ /shu bhaṃ mastu sarba dza ga taṃ/ dge ba 'di dang dge ba gzhan gyi mthus/ /drin chen ma gyur 'gro drug sems can rnams/ /gnas skabs tshe ring nad med 'byor ldan zhing / /mkha' spyod bgrod nas don gnyis lhun grub shog gi mtha' can/ rgyal rtse bdag po ngag dbang bsod nams rgyal mtshan gyis mdzad pa/ ༈ yang bsnyen thabs dgos 'dod kun 'byung nor bu'i do shal mgor/ na mo gu ru shrī badzra yo gi nī ye/ dus gsum rgyal ba'i spyi gzugs bla ma dang / /dbyer med rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor mar/ /zhes dang / mjug tu/ sa skya pa sngags 'chang ngag dbang kun dga' bkra shis kyis rang lo sum cur slebs thog e waṃ byang chub 'byung ba'i gnas su sbyar ba dge legs 'phel/ maṅga laṃ gyi mtha' can/

༈ yang bsnyen thabs blo gsal nyer mkho tshogs gsog kun dga' tshul khrims kyis mdzad pa mgor/ na mo gu ru bhyaḥ dpal ldan bla ma dam pa dang / /dbyer med rdo rje btsun mo dang / /zhes dang / mjug tu/ mnyes nas dam chos bdud rtsi yi/ /char rgyun bdag la dbab tu gsol/ /bkra shis sarba maṅga laṃ gyi mtha' can sangs rgyas phun tshogs kyi mchan bcas/ ༈ yang des mdzad pa'i bsnyen yig mgor/ bla ma dang rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma gnyis su med pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes dang / mjug tu/ mchog dang thun mong dngos grub bstsal du gsol/ bkra shis kyi mtha' can/ ༈ yang bsnyen thabs dngos grub myur 'gugs kyi pho nya mgor/ na mo gu ru badzra yo gi nī ye/ ma lus rigs kyi khyab bdag rdo rje chos/ /ma rig las 'khon sa skya'i 'jam mgon dang / /zhes dang / mjug tu/ bka' 'bangs kyi tha chung lhun grub kyis rang dang skal ba mnyam pa rnams la phan pa'i phyir thub bstan rwa ba smad kyi chos grwar sug bris su bgyis pa dge zhing bkra shis/ shu bhaṃ gyi mtha' can rmor chen gyis mdzad pa mchan gcig dang bcas pa/ ༈ yang gzhi bsnyen bya tshul don gnyer kun dga' bka' 'gyur ba sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan gyis mdzad pa mgor/ oṃ swa sti/ mkha' 'gro bye ba'i gtso mo'i mchog gyur dang / /zhes dang / mjug tu/ gus spro'i sgo nas myur bar bris pa'o/ /sarba maṅga laṃ gyi mtha' can rnams kyis bsnyen thabs skor dang / ༈ yang nā ro mkha' spyod kyi sbyin sreg 'phags pa rin po ches mdzad pa mgor/ dpal rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i sbyin sreg gi cho ga dpal rdo rje rnal 'byor ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bcom ldan ma'i bsnyen pa sngon du song ba'i zhes dang / mjug tu/ go go can gyis bskul nas 'phags pas sa mo sbrul gyi lo dbyar zla 'bring po la shangs mdor sbyar ba'o/ /maṅga laṃ gyi mtha' can/ ༈ yang rje btsun ma'i sbyin sreg mgor/ rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i sbyin sreg gi ngag 'don gyi rim pa ni zhes dang /

mjug tu/ gung rus nang po dbang chen pa la phul ba shu bhaṃ gyi mtha' can/ ༈ yang sbyin sreg sangs rgyas dpal bzang gi mdzad pa mgor/ rje btsun dam pa mi bskyod rdo rje'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bsam pa thag pas tshe 'di nyid dang / 'chi kha bar do'am 'gro ba ngan pas bar ma chod du skye ba/ zhes dang / mjug tu/ rje btsun dam pa gus pa chen po'i gsung bzhin du chos rje sangs rgyas dpal bzang gis bris pa'o/ /maṅga laṃ gyi mtha' can/ mchan phran bcas/ ༈ na mo gu ru buddha singha ya/ shes rab mchog gi lha mo dang / /mi 'gyur bde chen kha ṭwāṃ ga /ces dang / mjug tu/ brang ti pa'i bikṣu ga ga na shrī bha dras shing mo lug gi lo dpyid zla 'bring po'i dkar phyogs kyi tshes bcu gsum nyi ma me bzhi'i 'grub sbyor 'dzom pa'i nyin shrī e waṃ thar rtser sbyar ba'o/ /maṅga laṃ shu bhaṃ gyi mtha' can thar rtse paṇa chen gyi mdzad pa/ ༈ yang sbyin sreg gi cho ga mkha' spyod sgrub pa'i dga' ston dbang phyug rab brtan gyis mdzad pa mgor/ oṃ swasti/ rje btsun bla ma mkhyen brtse nus mthu'i dbang phyug gi zhabs kyi padmo la gus pas phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su mchi'o/ /byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ blo chen khrag 'thung dges nyams gsal mdzad cing / /zhes dang / mjug tu/ 'dis kyang slob bshad zab mo'i bstan pa rin po che dar zhing rgyas la yun ring du gnas par gyur cig shu bhaṃ gyi mtha' can/ ༈ yang sbyin sreg gi lag len gsal bar bshad pa'i yi ge mkha' spyod bgrod pa'i gsang lam mgor/ na mo gu ru buddha dhwa dza shrī badzra yo gi ni ye/ rgyal ba kun gyi spyi gzugs bla ma dang / /rdo rje btsun mo'i zhabs la gus btud nas/ /zhes dang / mjug tu/ legs byas 'dis mtshon dus gsum dge ba'i mthus/ /bdag dang gdul byar bcas pa'i sdig sgrib kun/ /byang zhing dag nas 'di dang phyi ma'i don/ /yid la re ba ji bzhin 'grub gyur cig

/kā lya na wardhuntu shu bhaṃ mastu sarba dza ga taṃ/ sarba maṅga laṃ gyi mtha' can mchan gcig bcas sa chen rdo rje 'chang ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams kyis mdzad pa/ ༈ yang las bzhi'i sbyin sreg rmor chen rdo rje 'chang gis mdzad pa mgor/ oṃ swasti/ rje btsun dpal ldan bla ma dang / /dbyer med rdo rje rnal 'byor mar/ /zhes dang / mjug tu/ ces mjug gi chos drug go /sarba maṅga laṃ gyi mtha' can/ ༈ yang sbyin sreg sgrib pa rnam sel kho bos brtsams pa mgor/ na mo gu ru badzra wā rā hi/ rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i sbyin sreg ces dang / mjug tu/ sa skya pa kun blos sbyar/ shu bhaṃ mastu sarba dza ga taṃ gyi mtha' can/ de rnams kyis bsnyen thabs dang sbyin sreg gi skor rdzogs nas/ ༈ bcu pa thun mong ma yin pa'i 'khrid 'pho ba dang bcas pa'i skor la thog mar/ rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i thun mong ma yin pa'i man ngag zhal shes gsum las/ bla ma bskyed bstim gyi zhal shes tshar chen rdo rje 'chang chen pos mdzad pa mgor/ gnyis pa bcad don nyams su len pa la/ mdun gyi nam mkhar dag gsal gnyis su med pa'i ye shes kyi snang ba las grub pa'i gzhal yas khang / zhes dang / mjug tu/ bla ma skyabs gnas kun 'dus su gyur maṅga laṃ/ 'dom gang nam mkhar 'od du zhu la khad/ /dmar ser li khri'i mdog ltar spyi gtsug baṃ thim nas/ /je cher/ lus stong gsum/ yal ba'i chos nyid/ stong nyid ngang las aṃ las sogs so/ /snying ga'i dkyil las gzhan ma lags/ /dus gsum rgyal ba sras bcas kyi/ /thugs rje cig char 'jug byed pa/ /zab lam bla ma'i man ngag 'di/ /snying gi dbus su gces par zungs/ /maṅga laṃ gyi mtha' can/ ༈ yang bla ma'i rnal 'byor dang mkha' spyod sgrub pa'i zhal shes yig chung mgor/ na mo badzra yo gi ni ye/ rje btsun nā ro pa'i lugs kyi mkha' spyod ma'i sgrub thabs la/ zhes dang / mjug tu/

rje btsun ma'i zhal gyi gdams pa bla ma sa skya pa'i man ngag ྀatsha/ gnas gnyis sbyong phyir 'od zer gyi/ /dag pa'i lha rten rang la bsdu/ /rlung la dbang dang cha lam kyang / /gnyis bral ched du zhal shes gsum/ /lha la rtsa ba su zhal shes/ bla ma'i gsung ngo bkra shis shog gi mtha' can/ tshar chen gyis mdzad 'dra snyam/ ༈ yang dbang bzhi lus bsgrigs kyi yig chung mgor/ na maḥshrī badzra yo gi nī ye/ rje btsun nā ro mkha' spyod kyi zhal shes/ zhes dang / mjug tu/ dbyangs yig ngo bo sngags phreng gis bskor ba'o/ /ྀatsha'i mtha' can/ ༈ yang de rjes mgor/ ngo bo dga' ba bzhi la zhes dang / mjug tu/ ces pa gong gi man ngag gnyis po 'di bla ma'i gsung ngo / /ྀatsha dpal nā ro pas slob ma gzhan la ma gnang zhing / pham mthing pa sku mched kho na la gnang ba de nyid las brgyud pa'i rje btsun sa skya pa yab sras kyi gdams pa khyad par can 'di nyid skal ldan gyi slob ma la chig brgyud kyi tshul du spel ba las snod min la mi spel ba'i bka' rgya dam po yod do/ /legs sbyar gyi gnad bla ma'i zhal nas dris/ sa ma ya ྀatsha'i mtha' can tshar chen gyis mdzad 'dra snyam pa/ ༈ yang dbang bzhi lus bsgrigs mkha' spyod sgrub pa 'pho ba rnams kyi zhal yig chung mgor/ 'di la rab mkha' spyod du tshegs med du 'gro ba dang / zhes dang / 'di ga rang la blo gtad 'cha' na da dung gab yig yod do'i mtha' can/ ༈ yang de rjes mgor/ bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'og gam lam gnyis brtsegs pa gnyis/ /zhes dang / mjug tu/ zhes sogs rgyud las gsal bar byung / /sa ma pa tha'i mtha' can mchan gnyis bcas yig rnying 'dra ba/ ༈ yang lus dkyil yig chung yid bzhin nor bu'i mgor/ na maḥbadzra yo gi nī ye/ rje btsun nā ro mkha' spyod kyi lus dkyil snyan brgyud nyams su len tshul ni/ zhes dang / mjug tu/ snying ltar gces pas dam du sba bar mdzod/ gu hya sa ma ya maṅga laṃ gyi mtha' can tshar chen gyis mdzad pa/

༈ yang lus dkyil yid bzhin nor bu zla gdan gyi khyad tsam ma gtogs gong mtshungs mgor/ na maḥbadzra yo gi nī ye/ rje btsun nā ro mkha' spyod kyi lus dkyil snyan brgyud nyams su len tshul ni/ zhes dang / mjug tu/ snying ltar gces pas dam du sba bar mdzod/ /gu hya sa mā ya mastu sarba dza ga taṃ/ 'di la yi ge'i gdan zla ba'i khyad tsam ma gtogs tshar chen gyis mdzad pa dang zhus dag pher zhing yig cha 'di klu sgrub kyi bka' 'bum nas rnyed pas rje de'i gsung rtsom los yin gyi mtha' can/ ༈ yang zab don snying po bsdus pa pha bla ma'i gsung gtsang ma mgor/ sngon 'gro dngos gzhi rjes gsum las/ zhes dang / mjug tu/ rtsa dang thig le lnga sogs gsal 'debs/ dza ga taṃ/ shu bhaṃ gyi mtha' can mdzad byang ma gsal zhing tshar lugs shig yin 'dra snyam pa/ ༈ yang snying gi gdung sel las bsam mi khyab kyi rnal 'byor thun mong ma yin pa'i gser chos mgor/ drin chen bla ma klu sgrub mchog /mkha' 'gro'i zhal bcud dri med gsung / /zhes dang / mjug tu/ byams pa rgyal mtshan bdag gis mgyogs par bris/ /dpal ldan bla ma dges pa'i bkra shis shog /dge'o'i mtha' can byang pa rab 'byams pas mdzad pa/ ༈ yang mkha' spyod sgrub pa'i gser chos chig brgyud mgor/ na ma gu ru badzra yo gi nī ye/ dpal 'khor lo bde mchog gi rtsa bshad kyi rgyud rnams su rje btsun yab la brten nas mkha' spyod sgrub pa/ yum la brten nas mkha' spyod sgrub/ ces dang / mjug tu/ mi dbang gzhon nu rdo rje rin chen dpal bzang po la snying nas gdams pa'i zab chos gu hya sa ma ya/ maṅga laṃ gyi mtha' can/ tshar chen gyis mdzad pa/ ༈ yang gsang khrid kyi dmigs rim mgor/ mkha' spyod gtso mo'i zab khrid nyams len rnams/ /go rim khrigs su bsdebs na 'di yin te/ /zhes dang / mjug tu/ nor 'khrul med par bkod pa'i brjed tho lags/ /sarba maṅga laṃ gyi mtha' can mdzad byang med pa/

༈ yang mgor/ bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo/ /'dir nā ro mkha' spyod kyi 'pho chung zhes dang / mjug tu/ gong gi dmigs pa rnams byas pas rung ngo / /dge'o'i mtha' can/ ༈ yang rdzogs rim rtsa dbu ma'i chos nyid dngos ston gyi byin rlabs lag len gsal bar bkod pa rdo rje 'chang sa chen kun dga' bsod nams kyis mdzad pa mgor/ na mo buddha dhwa dza shrī tsakra saṃ bha ra ye/ 'dir rdzogs rim rtsa dbu ma'i de kho na nyid dngos su ston pa'i man ngag dpal ldan bla ma dam pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan gyi gsung la/ zhes dang / mjug tu/ 'dis sa skya pa'i man ngag zab mo rnams kyi bka' mi chad pa'i rgyur gyur cig maṅga laṃ gyi mtha' can/ ༈ yang de rjes mgor/ 'di'i phyag len gyi brgyud pa ni zhes dang / mjug tu/ ces yar klungs pas 'di'i yig cha las 'byung ngo / /shu bhaṃ gyi mtha' can/ ༈ yang bsam mi khyab thun mong ma yin pa'i gser chos mgor/ bla ma dang rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /thun mong ma yin pa'i bsam mi khyab kyi rnal 'byor ni/ zhes dang / mjug tu/ zhes pa 'di yang ring mo bas brjed thor bris pa'o/ /maṅga laṃ gyi mtha' can mchan gcig bcas/ ༈ lus ma spangs mkha' spyod sgrub pa'i thabs mgor/ lus ma spangs mkha' spyod sgrub pa'i thabs/ drin zla med mkhyen gsal rgya mtsho yi/ /gsung bslu med gser chos man ngag 'di/ /thugs dad ldan dran pa gsol 'debs yin/ /zhes dang / mjug tu/ nā gardzu nas 'dar chos 'khor yang rtse'i btsan khang du cung zad gsal bar bris pa la bla ma mkha' 'gros dges pa'i phyag gis rnam pa kun tu gzung du gsol/ maṅga laṃ gyi mtha' can/ ༈ yang thun mong ma yin pa'i bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i rnal 'byor/ mkha' spyod sgrub pa'i nye lam mgor/ rje btsun bla ma mus pa chen po'i zhabs la phyag bgyi'o rjes su gzung du gsol/ thun mong ma yin pa'i bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i rnal 'byor ni/

zhes dang / mjug tu/ ces pa 'di la yang sa skya pa sngags 'chang ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams kyis bla ma gong ma'i gsung rgyun zin bris rnams las legs par btus te brjed thor bris so'i mtha' can/ ༈ yang des mkha' spyod sgrub pa'i thun mong ma yin pa'i snyan brgyud kyi man ngag nyams su len tshul mkha' spyod bgrod pa'i gsang lam mgor/ na mo gu ru buddha dhwa dza ya/ dkon mchog la skyabs gzhan phyir mkha' spyod sgrub/ /ces dang / mjug tu/ bkra shis dge legs kyi dpal dang ldan par gyur cig /shu bhaṃ gyi mtha' can/ rdo rje 'chang sa chen kun dga' bsod nams kyis mdzad pa mchan phran bcas/ ༈ yang man ngag zab mo gser chos chig brgyud ma mgor/ nang gi rnal 'byor ma ni skyabs 'gro sems bskyed rtsa gsum gsal btab pa/ zhes dang / mjug tu/ snga ma'i steng du len pa'i rnal 'byor pa la phan pas zur cig bris pa dge'o/ /maṅga laṃ/ rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i man ngag 'di rje btsun mus chen las sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams kyis thob bo'i mtha' can mdzad byang med pa/ ༈ yang de rjes nā ro mkha' spyod kyi gser chos chig brgyud ma mkha' spyod sgrub pa'i man ngag sogs kyi zhal shes khag che ba 'ga' zhig sa lo chen po'i phyag dpe las logs su bkod pa mgor/ na mo gu ru buddha dhwa dza ḍā ki nī ye/ 'dir sa lo 'jam pa'i rdo rje'i phyag dpe mkha' spyod ma'i man ngag zab bsdus zhig gi khrod na bsam gyis mi khyab thun mong ma yin pa sogs zhal gyi man ngag khag che ba 'ga' zhig 'dug pa de rnams 'dir bri bar bya'o/ /de yang sa lo 'jam dbyangs chen po'i phyag dpe de nyid las 'di ltar 'byung ste/ na maḥshrī badzra yo gi nī ye/ zhes dang / mjug tu/ rje btsun ma'i zhal gdams bla ma sa skya pa'i man ngag ྀatsha'i mtha' can/ ༈ yang de rjes mgor/ yang sa lo 'jam dbyangs chen po'i phyag dpe de nyid kyi khrod na/

bsam mi khyab thun mong ma yin pa sgom tshul cung zad mi 'dra ba 'di ltar yang bzhugs te zhes dang / mjug tu/ dga' 'o skyed do bsam don 'grub/ /sarba maṅga laṃ gyi mtha' can/ ༈ yang de rjes nyams len snying po bsdus pa mgor/ rang nyid rtsa gsum lte ba'i mkha' spyod gsal/ /zhes dang / mjug tu/ slar yang mkha' dbyings nas babs sngar ltar gyur/ kā lya na waddhantu'i mtha' can/ ༈ yang de rjes laṅga li ya'i sgrub tshul bklag chog ma mgor/ na mo gu ru buddha dhwa dza ye/ bla ma dang rnal 'byor ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /laṅga li ya'i sgrub pa ni/ zhes dang / mjug tu/ 'di dam tshig dang mi ldan pa rnams la shin tu gsang ngo / /sarba maṅga laṃ shu bhaṃ mastu sarba dza ga taṃ gyi mtha' can/ ༈ yang de rjes ngor chen rdo rje 'chang gi phyag dpe'i khrod nas rnyed pa'i nā ro mkha' spyod kyis bsam mi khyab thun mong ma yin pa'i yig rnying yid ches can mgor/ na mo badzra yo gi nī ye/ rdo rje rnal 'byor ma bsgom pa'i gang zag gis zhes dang / mjug tu/ de bzhin du 'gyur pa gcig chog rgyal po rje btsun mus pa chen pos byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ sarba maṅga laṃ gyi mtha' can mchan phran bcas la sde tshan gcig 'di rnams rdo rje 'chang sa chen kun dga' bsod nams kyi mdzad pa/ ༈ lus dkyil rnam bshad khog dbub 'jam dbyangs dga' ba'i gsung las byung ba mgor/ mchog gi bde bas rab myongs te/ /zhes dang / mjug tu/ rje bla ma'i gsung rgyun bris pa'o'i mtha' can/ ༈ yang de rjes mgor/ bla ma yi dam dges pa'i byin rlabs/ zhes dang / mjug tu/ 'dis 'gro ba rnams rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i sa la gnas pa'i bkra shis myur du byon cig shu bhaṃ gyi mtha' can/ dkon mchog rab brtan gyis mdzad pa/ ༈ yang ku sā li'i tshogs gsog gi ngag 'don sangs rgyas phun tshogs kyis mdzad pa mgor/ rang sems baṃ yig ces dang / mjug tu/ 'khrid yig tu blta'o/

/maṅga laṃ gyi mtha' can/ ༈ yang des mdzad pa'i lus dkyil ngag 'don mgor/ bdun pa 'gro ba dag pa'i rnal 'byor zhes dang / mjug tu/ sangs rgyas phun tshogs kyis so/ ༈ /yang des mdzad pa'i nyer mkho'i reg zig mgor/ rnal 'byor ma'i zin bris zhes dang / mjug tu/ mthar sangs rgyas na'ang 'di bzhin rgyas/ zhes pa'i rjes su/ gsung ngag pod dmar ma nas 'byung ba'i grub phra'i sdom tshig gi mthar sangs rgyas phun tshogs kyis smras pa'o/ /maṅga laṃ gyi mtha' can/ ༈ yang rtsa dbu ma'i 'khrid zab mo mgor/ bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo/ /jo bo nā ro ta pas gzhan la ma gnang ba'i thun mong ma yin pa'i gdams ngag ces dang / mjug tu/ 'di nyams su len pa'i rnal 'byor pa kun la phan pa'i bsam pas nye bar sbyar ba 'di yongs su rdzogs so/ /shu bhaṃ gyi mtha' can/ rje btsun gyi mdzad pa mchan bcas/ ༈ yang rtsa dbu ma'i 'khrid yig gsal byed bla ma dam pa'i gsung sgros yar klung pa seng ge rgyal mtshan gyis zin bris su btab pa mgor/ bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /jo bo nā ro ta pa'i man ngag rje btsun sa skya pa'i thugs kyi nying khu/ zhes dang / mjug tu/ dam pa'i zhabs rdul spyi bos len pa yar klung pa seng ge rgyal mtshan gyis zin bris su bkod pa'o/ /dge legs 'phel gyi mtha' can mchan bcas/ ༈ rtsa yig 'khrid yig mgor/ na mo gu ru badzra wā ra hi/ bskyed pa'i rim pa rdo rje rnal 'byor ma/ /zhes dang / mjug tu/ ltos shig sa ma pa ta/ dge'o'i mtha' can/ ༈ yang rtsa dbu ma'i 'khrid yig mus chen sems dpa' chen pos mdzad pa mgor/ gu ru shrī badzra yo gi nī/ bla ma dpal rdo rje rnal 'byor ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zab yangs rgyud rgyal gsang mtha'i don/ /zhes dang / mjug tu/ 'di ni mus pa chen po dkon chog rgyal mtshan nas brgyud pa'o/ /maṅga laṃ gyi mtha' can mchan bcas/ ༈ rtsa dbu ma'i 'khrid yig rje sems dpa' chen po'i gsung rgyun zin bris mgor/

oṃ swa sti siddhaṃ/ bla ma dang yi dam mkha' 'gro'i tshogs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'dir bla ma'i zhal las byung ba/ zhes dang / mjug tu/ ces pa 'di ni chos rje sems dpa' chen po'i gsung rang gi zin bris yi ger bris pa'o/ /dge'o/ /bkra shis par gyur cig 'di bris dge bas sangs rgyas myur thob shog /maṅga laṃ gyi mtha' can/ ༈ yang dbu ma'i gdams ngag mal lo'i gsung la sa chen gyis zin bris mdzad pa'i phyag dpe sgo rum dpe khang nas bdag chen rdo rje 'chang chen pos thon pa mgor/ bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la spyi bos phyag 'tshal lo/ /dngos po thams cad kyi de kho na nyid/ /ces dang mjug tu/ sangs zhes bya bar bzhed do'i mtha' can mchan phran bu bcas pa/ ༈ yang de rjes mgor/ bcom ldan 'das bde mchog la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rlung sbyong bar 'dod pas/ zhes dang / mjug tu/ sems gtad do/ /sa ma pa thi'i mtha' can mchan bcas/ ༈ yang de rjes dpal bde mchog la phyag 'tshal lo/ /lam nyams su blang ba'i zhes dang / mjug tu/ 'bras bur 'gyur ro/ /ྀatsha'i mtha' can mchan bcas/ ༈ yang de rjes mgor/ rtogs par bya ba'i zhes dang / mjug tu/ sa ma pa tha'i mtha' can mchan bcas/ ༈ yang de rjes mgor/ lte ba'i dkyil 'khor la zhes dang / mjug tu/ gdams ngag go'i mtha' can mchan bcas/ ༈ yang de rjes mgor/ 'di ni 'khor ba'i gnas lugs kyi tsakra ste/ zhes dang / mjug tu/ ye shes kyi rlung du grub bo'i mtha' can mchan bcas/ ༈ yang rtsa dbu ma'i 'khrid yig mus chen gyi gsung mkhyen rab chos rjes zin bris su btab pa mgor/ rtsa dbu ma'i 'khrid kyi zin bris la/ bshan pa srog gi gnad la mkhas pa/ zhes dang / mjug tu/ sems can thams cad tshe 'di la sangs rgyas thob pa'i rgyur gyur cig 'dis kyang bstan pa dang sems can la phan pa rgya chen po 'byung bar gyur cig dge'o/ /bkra shis kyi mtha' can/ ༈ yang dbu ma'i 'khrid yig e waṃ zung 'jug mngon gyur du ston byed mdzad byang mi gsal ba mgor/

oṃ swasti/ bla ma dam pa'i zhabs pad dang / /rnal 'byor ma la phyag byas nas/ /zhes dang / mjug tu/ sku gsum mngon gyur la 'god par shog dge'o'i mtha' can/ ༈ yang dbu ma'i zin bris mgor/ bde mchog zab mo'i snying po mchog /rlung sems dbu mar bcug nas ni/ /zhes dang / mjug tu/ 'di yang rje rin po che gung ru'i mtshan can gyis bris pa'o/ /maṅga laṃ bha wantu'i mtha' can/ ༈ yang dbu ma'i rgyun gyi nyams len gsang chen bcud kyi thig le mgor/ na ma gu ru badzra wā rā hi/ ma lus rgyal ba bskyed pa'i yum mchog ma/ /zhes dang / mjug tu/ snying dbus padmo bzhad gyur cig /maṅga laṃ gyi mtha' can/ tshar chen gyi mdzad pa/ ༈ yang rdzogs rim yab dang thun mong ba'i rtsa dbu ma'i 'khrid kyi zin bris mgor/ na maḥshrī gu ru badzra dhā ra ya/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ngo bo dpal ldan bla ma blo gsal rgya mtsho'i zhabs kyi padmo dri ma med pa la phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su mchi'o/ /rjes su gzung du gsol/ zhes dang / mjug tu/ 'dis kyang slob bshad zab mo'i bstan pa phyogs thams cad du khyab par gyur cig shu bhaṃ gyi mtha' can mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug gis mdzad pa/ ༈ yang dbu ma'i 'khrid mgor/ shrī tsakra nā tha dhī ka sha sā ga ra dhwa dza shrī bha dra ya/ khyab bdag 'khor lo'i mgon dang dbyer ma mchis pa rje btsun bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su mchi'o/ /zhes dang / mjug tu/ 'di'ang se'i rigs su skyes pa'i blo gsal chos dbang gi ming can gyis chos thun re re la bris pa maṅga laṃ gyi mtha' can/ ༈ yang 'khrid yig snying po'i zab bcud ces bya ba klu sgrub rgya mtsho'i gsung dri ma med pa byang pa rab 'byams pa nam mkha'i zin bris mgor/ snyan brgyud lam bzang skal ldan shing rta'i rgyun/ /yongs 'dzin dza hu'i thugs mtshor rab 'khyil ba/ /zhes dang / mjug tu/ yi ge pa ni rdzong ri pa byams pa'i ming can gyi bris pa dge

maṅga laṃ gyi mtha' can mchan phran bcas/ ༈ yang yab yum thun mong dang yum rkyang gi rlung sems dbu mar 'jug tshul gyi dmigs khrid sa skya pa 'jam mgon bsod nams dbang phyug gi gsung rgyun mgor/ na mo gu ru ḍā ki nī ye/ rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i chags bral rnal 'byor gyi lam la mos pa la/ zhes dang / mjug tu/ de nas rlung sems dbu mar bsdu tshul gyi dmigs pa sogs 'khrid yig bzhin lags/ shu bhaṃ gyi mtha' can/ ༈ 'khrid yig gser gyi yang zhun gyi kha skong rtsa dbu ma'i man ngag rmor chen gyis mdzad pa mgor/ slob bshad 'dzin pa'i mkhas grub tshogs rnams la/ /zhes dang / mjug tu/ kun tshul gyi yid dam du bya ba'i dpe'o/ /shu bhaṃ gyi mtha' can/ ༈ yab yum zhal sbyor dang yum rkyang gi 'pho ba sa chen gyis mdzad pa mgor/ na mo gu ru ḍā ki ni/ nā ro mkha' spyod kyi 'pho ba la sbyong ba dang / zhes dang / mjug tu/ gser chos bka' rgya ma ྀatsha'i mtha' can/ ༈ yang de rjes yum rkyang gi 'pho ba mgor/ rang rdo rje rnal 'byor mar bsgom pa'i zhes dang / mjug tu lo tsā ba'i man ngag ྀatsha/ bka' rgya ྀatsha'i mtha' can/ ༈ yang 'pho ba chig brgyud gser chos kyi gdams pa mal lo tsā ba'i gsung la rje sa chen gyis zin bris mdzad pa'i nyams len gyi snying po bsdus pa mgor/ dkon mchog la skyabs gzhan phyir 'pho ba bsgom/ zhes dang / mjug tu/ ces pa 'di yang sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dgas bris/ maṅga laṃ gyi mtha' can/ ༈ yang rje btsun yab yum la brten pa'i thun mong ma yin pa'i 'pho ba tshar chen rdo rje 'chang gi gsung rgyun mgor/ gang gis khyod zhabs dran tsam gyis/ /zhes dang / mjug tu/ rig pa brjod med du 'jog gi mtha' can/ ༈ yang de rjes yum rkyang gi 'pho ba mgor/ gnyis pa rje btsun yum la brten pa/ zhes dang / mjug tu/ dbyings rig bsre'o maṅga laṃ gyi mtha' can/ mdzad byang med pa/ ༈ yang 'pho ba rje btsun zhal sbyor dang yum rkyang gi 'pho ba bcas pa mgor/

rje btsun bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /jo bo nā ro ta pas pham mthing pa sku mched las gzhan la ma gnang ba'i gser chos zhes dang / mjug tu/ des rkyang pas ni rtogs par mi 'gyur ro/ /ྀatsha/ 'di sa skya pa'i gser chos kun dang thun mong ma yin pas snod min la gsang bar byas la snying dkyil du sba'o'i mtha' can mdzad byang med pa/ ༈ yang yab yum zhal sbyor gyi 'pho ba mgor/ rje btsun bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /jo bo nā ro ta pas pham mthing pa sku mched las gzhan la ma gnang ba'i gser chos zhes dang / mjug tu/ 'pho ba'i gdams pa rje btsun blo gsal ba'i/ /gsung las zin bris chos dbang rin chen no/ /maṅga laṃ gyi mtha' can/ ༈ yang shin tu zab pa'i 'pho ba chig brgyud ma mgor/ bla ma dam pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rdo rje rnal 'byor ma la brten nas btsan thabs su 'pho ba'i man ngag ni/ zhes dang / mjug tu/ bla ma mkhyen bdag cag dpon slob rnams mkha' spyod du thogs med du skye bar khyed kyis mkhyen brtse nus gsum gyi sgo nas byin gyis rlobs shig maṅga laṃ gyi mtha' can/ ༈ yang de rjes 'pho ba chig brgyud ma'i dri lan dogs gcod zin bris mgor/ rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i 'pho ba chig brgyud ma bsgom par 'dod pas/ zhes dang / mjug tu/ ces pa 'di ni mus chen 'khor lo sdom pa'i gsung ji lta ba bzhin sa skya pa shākya'i dge slong ā nandas gling dga' bsam gtan phug gi rje dam pa'i gzims phug mdor rje'i zhabs drung nyid du bris pa'o/ /sarba maṅga laṃ gyi mtha' can sa chen rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bsod nams kyis mdzad pa/ ༈ 'pho ba sangs rgyas phun tshogs kyis mdzad pa mgor/ rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i 'pho ba mang yang / zhes dang / mjug tu/ sangs rgyas phun tshogs kyis bris pa'o/ /maṅga laṃ gyi mtha' can/ ༈ yang 'da' kha ma'i zin bris rmor chen gyis mdzad pa mgor/ swasti/

mchog gsum 'gro ba'i bla mar gus btud nas/ /zhes dang / mjug tu/ bya bral bas rmor dgon par bris pa'o/ /maṅga laṃ gyi mtha' can/ ༈ yang des mdzad pa'i mkha' spyod skor gsum gyi glegs bam dkar chag zab don gnad kyi lde mig mgor/ na mo gu ru badzra yo gi nī ye/ 'phags yul paṇa grub du ma'i thugs kyi bcud zhes dang / mjug tu/ phyogs thams cad du dar zhing rgyas la yun ring du gnas par gyur cig shu bhaṃ mastu sarba dza ga taṃ gyi mtha' can/ ༈ yang gzhan la 'chi khar 'pho ba 'debs tshul lhag bsam rab dkar kho bos sbyar ba mgor/ na mo gu ru badzra wā rā hi/ gzhan la 'chi khar 'pho ba 'debs tshul/ zhes dang / mjug tu/ 'od zer gyis bgyis pa dge legs 'phel gyi mtha' can/ de rnams kyis thun mong ma yin pa'i 'khrid 'pho ba dang bcas pa'i skor rdzogs nas/ ༈ bcu gcig pa smon lam dang bkra shis kyi skor la/ ༈ mkha' spyod zhal bzang lta ba'i smon lam mgor/ na mo badzra tsaṇḍa lī ye/ mtha' yas rgyal ba'i bde stong zlos gar ni/ /zhes dang / mjug tu/ ces kyang thol byung du smras so/ /bkra shis par gyur cig gi mtha' can tshar chen gyis mdzad pa/ ༈ yang kho bos sbyar ba'i 'dod gsol mgor/ na mo gu ru badzra wā ra hi/ rgyal ba sras bcas spro bsdu'i bdag nyid can/ /zhes dang / mjug tu sbyar ba dge legs 'phel gyi mtha' can/ ༈ yang de rjes mgor/ mchog gsum kun 'dus rtsa brgyud bla ma sogs/ /zhes dang / mjug tu/ kun blos smras pa sarba maṅga laṃ gyi mtha' can/ ༈ yang rnal 'byor ma'i bkra shis mgor/ shrī tsakra saṃ bha ra ye/ bkra shis gang zhig chos kyi dbyings las legs byung ba/ /zhes dang / mjug tu/ rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi bkra shis 'di sgrub mchod kyi cha rkyen du dge slong puṇya bas bris pa lags/ dge zhing bkra shis kyi mtha' can/ glo bo mkhan chen gyis mdzad pa/ ༈ yang bkra shis dge legs kyi dpal ster mgor/

oṃ swasti siddhaṃ/ bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo/ /phun tshogs dge legs kun gyi dpal mnga' ba/ /zhes dang / mjug tu/ byams pa chos legs kyis bde ldan ri khrod du sbyar ba'o/ /shu bhaṃ gyi mtha' can/ de rnams kyis smon lam dang bkra shis kyi skor rdzogs nas/ ༈ zhar byung dpe ris kyi skor la/ sngags dag par bya ba sngags btu'i re mig ind+ra bhu ti'i gzhung las byung ba/ rje btsun sgo rum pa'i zhus dag dang / mkhyen brtse'i phyag bris kyi bu dpe las bshus pa khungs btsun/ de nas gzhan yang bshad bya ba sogs rgyab yig dang bcas pa/ ༈ yang sngags btu lugs gcig rgyab yig dang bcas pa ste/ 'di gnyis ind+ra'i gzhung las 'byung kyang phag mo spyi 'gro'i sngags yin pas 'dir sbyar/ ༈ yang sindhu ra'i dkyil 'khor sgrub mchod kyi dpe chung la/ sku tshom bu/ gsung bdud rtsi/ thugs sindhu ra'i dkyil 'khor rnams shom tshul bzhin bris pa'i mthar chu gnyis sngon 'gro'i nyer mchod kyis bskor ba'i g.yas su 'das gtor zlum po padma'i dbyibs can/ sngon 'gro gtor ma/ dur bdag gtor ma/ g.yon du 'jig rten pa'i gtor ma'i dpe ris rnams phyogs gcig dang / ༈ yang sku tshom bu/ thugs sindhur/ lus dkyil bsgom pa'i dpe ris rnams phyogs gcig dang / ༈ yang sbyin sreg gi thab dpe thar rtse nam mkha' dpal bzang gis yi ge dang mthun pa ngor pa'i phyag len la mdzad pa dang / sangs rgyas dpal bzang gi sbyin sreg gi yi ge dang mthun pa las thams cad mkhyen pa'i thab dpe gnyis sde tshan gcig dang / chos nyid dngos ston gyi maṇḍal dpe ris/ ༈ yang kha'u brag rdzong pa'i lugs kyi thab dpe dbang phyug rab brtan gyi sbyin sreg gi yi ge dang mthun pa/ me yol gyi dpe ris dang bcas pa/ ༈ yang dbang phyug rab brtan gyis mdzad pa'i thab dpe tshar lugs rnams kyi phyag len la mdzad pa me yol gyi dpe ris dang bcas pa/

༈ yang kho bos bcos pa'i sngags 'chang thams cad mkhyen pa kun dga' bsod nams kyi sbyin sreg gi yig cha dang mthun pa'i thab dpe thig dpe dang bcas pa/ ༈ yang gnas lugs rtsa yi 'khor lo rtsa dbu ma'i dpe ris 'bras dus dbu mar chud pa'i e waṃ zung 'jug gi dpe ris/ bsgom pa'i dus kyi 'khor lo'i dpe ris rnams sde tshan gcig dang bcas pa ste/ de rnams kyi sgo nas rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i be'u bum zab mo zhar byung dpe ris dang bcas pa yongs su rdzogs nas/ de ltar na rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i be'u bum 'di la gong 'og gi chings bsgrigs 'di thams cad gtso bor thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa'i khyad rnams dang man ngag gi go rim dang bla ma snga phyi'i rim pas sde tshan so sor bsgrigs pa ste/ de yang dper brjod na/ brgyud 'debs la ngor chen gyis mdzad pa'i brgyud 'debs gtsor gyur gyi brgyud rim gsol 'debs rnams sde tshan gcig dang / de bzhin du sgrub thabs dkyil chog sogs phal che ba bla ma snga phyi'i rim pas bsgrigs shing / 'on kyang zab khyad rnams rjes su bzhugs pa'i stabs kyis thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa'i khrid skor 'di la bla ma gong ma 'ga' zhig mdzad pa'i yig cha rnams 'og tu 'byung ba'i rgyu mtshan yang de ltar yin zhing / 'dir yang rtsol ba chen pos gsung rab so so nas yig cha rnams bsdus pas bzhugs tshogs che mod/ 'on kyang da dung dad ldan gyi slob ma blo gros can 'ga' zhig nas dang 'dod yid ches kyi spros pa byed tshe da dung stod mnga' ris/ bar dbus gtsang / smad mdo khams phyogs na bzhugs pa'i mkhas grub kyi bla ma rnams kyi yig cha sngon byon gong ma'i gsung la gsal byed dang / gsar du spel ba'i legs bshad bdud rtsi'i thigs phreng spyi bye brag gi bstan pa la bkur stir 'gyur nges rnams phyogs gcig tu bsdoms tshe pusta ka gnyis gsum tsam longs pas ha cang mang ches stabs bdag gis 'dir dkar chag tu bkod ma nus pas dag snang mdzad tshe snyan brgyud bzhugs nges kyi bla ma rnams la gsol ba rtse gcig tu btab ste/

slar rim par dkar chag tu 'debs par zhu/ 'dir smras pa/ zab yangs rgyud sde'i rin chen 'byung gnas las/ /snyan brgyud grub dbang dam pa'i ded dpon gyis/ /legs blangs gdams pa yid bzhin nor bu yi/ /mdzod 'dzin sa skya pa las gzhan du ci/ /bar skabs gyi tshigs bcad do/ /de dag gis rje btsun mkha' spyod dbang mo'i chos skor dkar chag yongs su bkod zin nas/ ༈ da ni sde tshan gcig pa'i phyir sa skya pa'i gser chos/ ind+ra mai tri'i chos skor dang / dpyal lugs phag mo sgor gsum gyi sgrub thabs byin rlabs chos skor sogs phyogs gcig tu bkod pa'i thog mar/ ༈ ind+ra mkha' spyod kyi brgyud 'debs dpal mchog ma rmor chen gyis mdzad pa mgor/ swa sti/ dpal mchog dang po'i sangs rgyas rdo rje 'chang / /zhes dang / mjug tu/ 'chi med klu sdings su bris pa'o/ /shu bhaṃ gyi mtha' can/ rgyal chen ind+ra bhu tis mdzad pa'i ind+ra mkha' spyod du grags pa'i chos skor la/ mi dbang chos gsum gyi dang po/ ༈ sgrub thabs kyi rgya gzhung mgor/ rgya gar skad du/ shrī badzra yo gi nī siddhaṃ/ bod skad du/ rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i sgrub pa/ rdo rje rnal 'byor ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /stong nyid snying rje'i bdag nyid can/ /zhes dang / mjug tu/ slob dpon chen po o rgyan gyi mi dbang ind+ra bhu tis mdzad pa rdzogs so/ /rgya gar gyi mkhan po dpal na lend+ra pa dang / lo tsā ba dge slong pradzñā kirtas bsgyur ba'o/ /shu bhaṃ gyi mtha' can mchan bcas/ ༈ yang des mdzad pa'i sngags kyi de kho na nyid kyi rgya gzhung mgor/ /rgya gar skad du/ shrī badzra yo gi nī man tra arpa sd+ya twa ta ni da de sha swa dhi ṣṭa krom pa de sha nā maḥ zhes dang / mjug tu/ slob dpon ind+ra bhū ti chen pos mdzad pa rdzogs so/ /slob ma ye shes rdo rjes bsgyur cing zhus te bcos pa'o/ /shu bhaṃ gyi mtha' can mchan bcas/

༈ yang mi dbang chos gsum las las bcu'i gdams ngag bha len dra ru tses mdzad pa mgor/ rgya gar skad du/ shi shya a nu gra ha bi di/ bod skad du/ gzhan don slob ma rjes su bzung ba'i cho ga ces dang / mjug tu/ rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i zhal gyi man ngag bla ma bha lend+ra ru tses mdzad pa rdzogs so/ /bla ma mal lo tsā ye shes rdo rje thugs rdo rje chen po dang ldan pas bsgyur ba'o/ /maṅga laṃ/ shin tu zab pa'i chos su gda'i mtha' can mchan bcas/ ༈ yang ind+ra bhū ti'i sgrub thabs rgya gzhung gong gi de dang cung mi 'dra ba mgor/ rgya gar skad du/ shrī badzra yo gi ni si ti/ bod skad du/ dpal rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i sgrub thabs/ rdo rje rnal 'byor ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /stong nyid snying rje'i bdag nyid can/ /zhes dang / mjug tu/ slob dpon chen po in dra bhu ti yis mdzad pa rdzogs so/ /bsod nams 'byung gnas dang / smad dge slong chos 'bar gyis zhus te gtan la phab pa'o/ ༈ yang de rjes gtum mo sgom tshul mgor/ rdo rje phag mo la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rlung gi bskyod pas 'og gi 'khor lo nas/ /zhes dang / mjug tu/ kun dga' dang bcas ral gyen gshegs/ /phag mos khyod kyi sems la gsal gyur cig gi mtha' can/ ༈ yang de rjes phyi rol mchod pa'i cho ga mgor/ rdo rje'i rnal 'byor ma/ rdo rje sngon po phag mo la/ zhes dang / mjug tu/ phyi rol gyi mchod pa'i cho ga'o'i mtha' can/ ༈ yang de rjes phyi rol mchod pa bya tshul mgor/ de nas brtson chen phyi rol mchod pa'i tshul/ /zhes dang / mjug tu/ de kho na nyid ye shes grub pa las bsgom pa'i cho ga'o'i mtha' can/ ༈ yang de rjes slob mas rjes gzung gi cho ga mgor/ slob mas maṇḍal bya zhing zhabs padmor/ /zhes dang / mjug tu/ phan yon slob ma rjes su bzung ba'i cho ga'o'i mtha' can/ ༈ yang de rjes sngags btu mgor/ de nas rdo rje rnal 'byor mas/
