/sngags btu mchog tu 'gyur ba bzhin/ /zhes dang / mjug tu/ sngags btu ba'i cho ga'o'i mtha' can/ ༈ yang de rjes mchod pa'i cho ga mgor/ mchod pa'i rgyu ni cho ga mkhas rnams kyi/ /zhes dang / mjug tu/ de kho na nyid ye shes grub pa zhes bya ba bdag byin gyis brlabs pa zhes bya ba rdzogs so/ /dpal 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyis byin gyis brlabs pa mkhas pa chen po'i zhal snga nas zhabs kyi rdul dri la reg pa paṇḍi ta stong nyid ting nge 'dzin gyis mdzad pa'o/ /bal po'i a tsa ra bha rant+ra len dra ru tse dang / lo tsā ba rngog go /maṅga laṃ gyis mtha' can rnams sde tshan gcig pa mtshan shin tu mang ba dang bcas pa/ ༈ yang mi dbang chos gsum gyi 'grel pa zhal gnyis pa'i sgrub thabs dang phag mo las bcu mgor/ oṃ swasti siddhaṃ/ bskal pa'i me dang 'dra ba'i 'od ldan zhing / /zhes dang / mjug tu/ tshe 'di nyid la 'grub par 'gyur bar shog /bkra shis par gyur cig gi mtha' can/ ༈ yang sngags kyi de nyid mgor/ oṃ swa sti siddhaṃ/ dpal ldan bla ma rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i/ /zhabs la dad cing gus pas phyag btsal nas/ /zhes dang / mjug tu/ rnal 'byor pa grags pa rgyal mtshan gyis nye bar sbyar ba'o/ /shu bhaṃ mastu sarba dza ga taṃ gyi mtha' can/ ༈ yang bsnyen sgrub dang slob ma rjes bzung gi cho ga la mgor/ oṃ swasti siddhaṃ/ bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rdo rje 'chang dang rje btsun bla ma dang / /zhes dang / mjug tu/ rjes su bzung ba'i cho ga bstan zin to'i mtha' can/ ༈ de rjes tshogs mchod mgor/ gsum pa tshogs kyi 'khor lo'i cho ga la yang / zhes dang / mjug tu/ tshogs kyi bya ba bstan zin to'i mtha' can/ ༈ de rjes gzhon nu ma mchod pa mgor/ don bzhi pa gzhon nu ma mchod pa byed par 'dod na/ zhes dang / mjug tu/ gzhon nu ma'i mchod pa bstan zin to'i mtha' can/ ༈ de rjes gtor chog mgor/ lnga pa gnas skabs thams cad dang 'brel ba gtor ma'i cho ga ni zhes dang /

mjug tu/ gtor ma'i cho ga bstan zin to'i mtha' can/ ༈ de rjes sbyin sreg mgor/ drug pa sbyin sreg la gnyis/ nang gi dang phyi'o/ /zhes dang / mjug tu/ sbyin sreg bstan zin to'i mtha' can/ ༈ de rjes bsrung 'khor mgor/ bdun pa bsrung ba'i 'khor lo 'bri ba ni/ /zhes dang / mjug tu/ bsrung ba'i 'khor lo bstan zin to'i mtha' can/ ༈ de rjes sumbha ni'i cho ga mgor/ brgyad pa sumbha ni'i cho ga ni/ zhes dang / mjug tu/ sumbha ni'i cho ga bstan zin to'i mtha' can/ ༈ de rjes dgu pa bsgom pas phyir bzlog pa mgor/ de nas bsgom pas phyir bzlog pa ni/ zhes dang / mjug tu/ bsgom pas phyir bzlog pa bstan zin to/ ༈ /de rjes bris pas phyir bzlog pa mgor/ bcu pa bris pas phyir bzlog pa ni zhes dang / mjug tu/ rnal 'byor pa grags pa rgyal mtshan gyis yi ger bkod pa'i mtha' can/ rgyud yig la mchan bcas/ de rnams kyis las bcu rdzogs nas/ ༈ de rjes don grub ma'i sgrub thabs mgor/ na maḥbadzra bhā ra ni ye/ lus gzhal yas khang du bsgom pa'i zhes dang / mjug tu/ rjes gnang rnams dus gcig tu mdzad snang ngo / /maṅga laṃ gyi mtha' can/ rje btsun rin po ches mdzad pa rnams sde tshan gcig dang / ༈ yang zhal gnyis ma'i sgrub thabs ngag 'don mgor/ bla ma dam pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dpal rdo rje rnal 'byor ma sgrub par 'dod pas/ zhes dang / mjug tu/ 'jigs pa gang gis kyang mi tshugs shing dngos grub thams cad thob par 'gyur ro/ /shu bhaṃ gyi mtha' can gong ma'i gsung rgyun rnying ma/ ༈ yang zhal gnyis ma'i sgrub thabs paṇḍi ta grags pa rgyal mtshan gyis mdzad pa mgor/ na mo gu ru bhyaḥ rdo rje phag mo'i sgrub thabs nyams su len par 'dod pas/ zhes dang / mjug tu/ ces pa 'di yang ma ti tsi tras brag dkar chos sdings su sbyar ba'o/ /dge zhing bkra shis kyi mtha' can mchan bcas/ ༈ yang zhal gnyis ma'i bsrung 'khor shin tu zab pa mgor/

na mo badzra yo gi nī/ 'di'i 'khor lo bsgom par 'dod pas/ skyabs su 'gro ba dang / zhes dang / mjug tu/ mdo spyod gzims khang du legs par bris pa'o/ /maṅga laṃ/ dge bar gyur cig gi mtha' can/ glo bo mkhan chen gyis mdzad pa/ ༈ yang byin rlabs kyi yi ge gung rus mdzad pa mgor/ phag mo zhal gnyis ma 'di rgyal po ind+ra bhu ti'i mdzad pa 'dra yang / zhes dang / mjug tu/ blo gros brtan pa/ dpal ldan tshul khrims/ rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po'i/ shu bhaṃ gyi mtha' can/ ༈ yang byin rlabs bya tshul mgor/ na mo badzra wā ra hye/ rgyal ba kun gyi yum gyur pa'i/ /rdo rje btsun mo la btud nas/ /zhes dang / mjug tu/ dben gnas gling kha bde ba can du sbyar ba'o/ /bista ro da ya bha wantu'i mtha' can/ sa los mdzad pa/ ༈ yang mngon rtogs mgor/ bla ma dang rje btsun rnal 'byor ma gnyis su med pa la phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su mchi'o/ /zhes dang / mjug tu/ klu sgrub bdag gis sbyar ba dge zhing bkra shis kyi mtha' can/ ༈ yang dbang chog snying po gsal ba mgor/ bla ma dang rje btsun rnal 'byor ma gnyis su med pa la phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su mchi'o/ /zhes dang / mjug tu/ ku sa li'i bandhe nā gardzu nas dpal gnyan yod kyi bla brang dkar po'i gzim chung tshe ring gur khang du sbyar ba'o/ /maṅga laṃ gyi mtha' can klu sgrub kyis mdzad pa/ ༈ yang sgrub thabs dang byin rlabs kyi cho ga bklag chog tu bkod pa mgor/ padma mi ro nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor steng / /skye dgu'i skyabs gcig rdo rje rnal 'byor ma/ /zhes dang / mjug tu/ skye dgu rnams bde legs su gyur cig /brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang / rdo rje phag mo/ grub chen lā ba pa/ zhes pa nas/ rje bla ma dbang phyug rab brtan/ des bdag la'o'i mtha' can/ ngag dbang chos grags kyis mdzad pa/ de rnams kyis ind+ra mkha' spyod phag mo zhal gnyis ma'i skor rdzogs nas/ ༈

mai tri mkha' spyod kyi skor la/ thog mar/ ༈ mai tri mkha' spyod dam rig pa 'dzin ma rtsen dmar grags pa'i chos skor yongs rdzogs las/ rgyud kyi dum bu rje btsun chen po'i gsung mchan dang bcas pa mgor/ de na yang dag par bshad par bya ste/ zhes dang / mjug tu/ phyis rgya gar du byon nas bla ma a nyid las gsan gyi mtha' can mchan bcas/ ༈ yang de rjes sgrub thabs rgya gzhung mgor/ rgya gar skad du/ bi dya dhā ri ki li shrī badzra wā rā hī sa dhā na/ bod skad du/ rdo rje phag mo rig pa 'dzin ma rtsen ma'i sgrub pa'i thabs/ dpal rdo rje rnal 'byor ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes dang / mjug tu/ sgrub thabs slob dpon gnyis med rdo rjes mdzad pa rdzogs so'i mtha' can mchan bcas/ ༈ yang rjes gnang gi cho ga rgya gzhung mgor/ rgya gar skad du/ bi dya dhā ri ki li badzra yo gi nī adzña bi dhi/ bod skad du/ rig pa 'dzin ma rtsen ma rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i rjes su gnang ba'i cho ga dpal rdo rje rnal 'byor ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes dang / mjug tu/ paṇḍi ta de nyid dang btsun pa dar ma yon tan gyis bsgyur ba'o/ /shu bhaṃ sarba dza ga taṃ gyi mtha' can rje btsun gyi gsung mchan dang bcas pa/ ༈ yang sgrub thabs byin rlabs dang bcas pa mgor/ na mo gu ru badzra yo gi nī/ 'gro la rab chags dmar ba'i mdangs ldan zhal gcig spyan gsum gyen du gzigs/ /zhes dang / mjug tu/ lcags pho byi lo'i brgyad pa'i brgyad la spro lung nag phug dgon par sbyar gyi mtha' can/ ༈ yang de rjes bstod pa mgor/ na mo gu ru badzra yo gi nī/ yon tan mtha' yas rgyal ba kun gyi dngos/ /zhes dang / mjug tu/ mi rje'i bzhugs gnas yul chos khab tu sbyar/ maṅga laṃ bha wantu shu bhaṃ gyi mtha' can/ 'di gnyis spro lung kun smon gyis mdzad pa/ ༈ yang mngon dkyil mgor/ bla ma dang rig pa 'dzin pa rtsen ma'i rnal 'byor ma la phyag 'tshal lo/

/zhes dang / mjug tu/ kun dga'i ming can bdag gis bkod/ /mai tri mkha' spyod kyi sgrub thabs sa ma pa tha'i mtha' can/ dga' ldan pa kun bsod kyis mdzad pa/ ༈ yang de rjes/ mai tri mkha' spyod kyi sgrub thabs gsal byed nyan chen po'i gsung sgros sgom pas skyo na sngags bzla bar bya'o/ /ྀatsha'i mtha' can/ ༈ yang mngon dkyil dngos grub dpal 'byung mgor/ blo gsal mkhas pa'i gru bzung nas/ mai tri mkha' spyod rgya mtsho cher/ /zhes dang / mjug tu/ stag lo zla ba gnyis pa'i dkar phyogs yon tan mtha' dag nya gang zhing rdzogs pa lnga'i tshes la sbyar ba dge zhing bkra shis kyi mtha' can klu sgrub rgya mtshos mdzad pa/ ༈ yang mai tri mkha' spyod kyi mngon rtogs mgor/ mkhyen yangs blo gros gsal ba dpal gyi ri/ /rnam thar rtse brgyad zlum po'i me tog tshal/ /zhes dang / mjug tu/ smon lam dang bkra shis kyis mtha' brgyan par bya'o/ /maṅga laṃ gyi mtha' can mchan gcig bcas klu sgrub rgya mtshos mdzad pa/ ༈ yang byin rlabs kyi zur 'debs mgor/ yang dpal gyi rir grub chen sha ba ris byin gyis brlabs pa rjes mai tri ba'i phag mo 'di ni/ zhes dang / mjug tu/ 'on kyang 'di rnams bla ma spro lung pa kun smon gyi yig cha rnams dgos gsung ngo / /dge'o'i mtha' can gung rus mdzad pa/ ༈ yang sgrub thabs dang byin rlabs go bde bklag chog tu bkod pa mgor/ 'gro la rjes chags dmar ba'i mdangs 'od can/ /zhes dang / mjug tu/ sum pa lotstsha ba dar ma yon tan/ rje btsun grags pa/ chos rje khu dbon/ man ind+ra mkha' spyod dang 'dra/ dge'o/ /bkra shis so'i mtha' can ngag dbang chos grags kyis mdzad pa/ de rnams kyis mai tri mkha' spyod kyi skor yongs su rdzogs nas/ ༈ zhar byung ind+ra mai tri'i dpe ris skor la/ de gnyis kyi sku tshom bu'i dkyil 'khor/ thugs sindhu ra'i dkyil 'khor/ 'das gtor/ 'jig rten pa'i gtor ma sngon 'gro gtor ma'i dpe ris dang bcas pa ste rje btsun sa skya pa'i gser chos ind+ra mai tri gnyis kyi skor rdzogs nas/

༈ dpyal lugs kyi phag mo'i skor la/ thog mar rgya gzhung sgrub thabs mgor/ rgya gar skad du/ sarba artha siddha pa ta na ma/ bod skad du/ don thams cad grub pa zhes bya ba'i sgrub thabs/ rdo rje phag mo la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes dang / mjug tu/ slob dpon chen po mkhas pa grub pa a wa dhū ti pas mdzad pa rdzogs so/ /bal po a tsarya bha rand+ra ru rtse dang / lo tsā ba blo ldan shes rab kyis bsgyur ba'o'i mtha' can mchan bcas/ ༈ yang de rjes sgrub thabs rgya gzhung ye shes 'pho ba zhes bya ba mgor/ rgya gar skad du/ dzñā na be sha na ma/ bod skad du/ ye shes 'pho ba zhes bya ba rdo rje rnal 'byor ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes dang / mjug tu/ ye shes dbab pa'i cho ga las bsgom pa'i cho ga'i mtha' can mchan bcas/ ༈ de rjes slob ma rjes gzung gi cho ga mgor/ slob ma gus ldan zhabs pad la btud rnams kyis gsol ba btab gyur bla ma yi/ /zhes dang mjug tu/ slob ma rjes su bzung ba'i cho ga'o mtha' can mchan bcas/ ༈ yang phyi rol mchod pa'i cho ga mgor/ yang dag grub dang slob ma bzang 'dzin pa'i cho ga phyi rol cho ga byed gyur pa'i zhes dang / mjug tu/ phyi rol mchod pa'i cho ga'o'i mtha' can mchan bcas/ ༈ yang 'khor lo mchod pa'i cho ga mgor/ gang bshad zin cho ga mchog gi nyin re bzhin ni 'khor lo mchod cing / zhes dang / mjug tu/ ye shes dbab pa zhes bya ba rnal 'byor gyi cho ga dpal stong nyid ting nge 'dzin gyis mdzad pa rdzogs so'i mtha' can/ ༈ yang de rjes dbu bcad ma'i sgrub thabs rgya gzhung mgor/ rgya gar skad du/ tsandha mundha badzra wā ra hi sa dhā na/ bod skad du/ rdo rje phag mo dbu bcad ma'i sgrub thabs/ dpal rdo rje phag mo dbu bcad ma'i sgrub thabs/ dpal rdo rje phag mo la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes dang / mjug tu/ lakṣi mas mdzad pa'i sgrub thabs rdzogs so/ /khu dge bshes ne tsos bsgyur ba'o mtha' can/

༈ yang de rjes dbu bcad ma'i sgrub thabs rgya gzhung mgor/ rgya gar skad du/ tsaṇḍa muṇḍa paḍā na ma/ bod skad du/ dbu bcad ma'i sgrub thabs zhes bya ba/ dpal rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes dang / mjug tu/ 'di bram ze yin/ birwa pas mdzad pa rdzogs so/ /bal po'i paṇḍi ta bha lend+ra ru tse dang / bod kyi lotstsha ba sma chos 'bar gyis bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa'o'i mtha' can mchan bcas/ ༈ de rjes sbyin sreg gi cho ga rgya gzhung mgor/ rgya gar skad du/ shrī badzra yo gi ni ho ma bi ṭi/ bod skad du/ dpal rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i sbyin sreg gi cho ga dpal rdo rje rnal 'byor ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes dang / mjug tu/ sangs rgyas sbyin gyis mdzad pa'o/ /bal po'i paṇḍi ta bha len ru tsi dang / lotstsha ba blo ldan shes rab kyis bsgyur ba'o'i mtha' can/ mchan bcas pa rnams sde tshan gcig dang / ༈ yang rnal 'byor ma'i brgyud pa'i rnam thar mgor/ na mo gu ru badzra dha ra ya/ rab yangs bde stong mkha' dbyings la/ /zhes dang / mjug tu/ bla ma dge ba'i bshes gnyen du ma'i zhal ngor bsod snyoms pa rin chen rgyal mtshan gyis gtsang g.yas su nyug gi phu rdzong kha'i dben gnas dam par yi ger bkod pa la bla ma mkha' 'gro'i tshogs kyis bzod par mdzad cing byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ ྀatsha maṅga laṃ gyi mtha' can/ ༈ yang rdzogs rim sgom pa drug pa'i 'khrid yig mgor/ bla ma dam pa rnams dang dpal rdo rje rnal 'byor ma la phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su mchi'o/ /bla ma sman lung pa dpyal kun dga' rdo rjes zhes dang / mjug tu/ gdams pa'i gnad kyis zin par byas nas byung rgyal du mnyam rjes 'brel bar bskyangs pas myur du rdo rje 'chang 'grub par 'gyur ro'i mtha' can mdzad byang med pa/ ༈ yang byin rlabs kyi tho yig mkhan chen bsod nams lhun grub kyis mdzad pa mgor/ na mo badzra wā rā hi/

'dir bla ma dpyal pa rnams las brgyud pa'i rje btsun rdo rje phag mo rigs gsum bsgom par 'dod pas/ zhes dang / mjug tu/ dge slong puṇya bas bris so/ /'di'i byin rlabs kyi brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang / rdo rje rnal 'byor ma/ lakṣiṃ ka ra/ zhes pa nas so sor byung na legs gsung ngo / /maṅga laṃ gyi mtha' can/ ༈ yang byin rlabs bya tshul mgor/ spyir bcom ldan 'das phag mo la dkyil 'khor yongs rdzogs dang / zhes dang / mjug tu/ thams cad mkhyen pa kun dga' bzang po'o/ /'di yang rje gung ru bas mdzad pa'o/ /shu bhaṃ gyi mtha' can/ ༈ yang sgrub thabs dang byin rlabs kyi cho ga khrigs chags su bkod pa ngag dbang chos grags kyis mdzad pa mgor/ sangs rgyas kun gyi yum gyur rnal 'byor ma/ /zhes dang / mjug tu/ rjes bsngo ba dang smon lam bya'o'i mtha' can/ ༈ yang de rjes byin rlabs bya tshul mgor/ 'jig rten mig gyur dpyal lor grags pa yi/ /zhes dang / mjug tu/ tshom rngam sngags kyi bsrung ba bya zhing smon lam rnam par dag pas rgyas gdab bo/ /ྀatsha'i mtha' can mchan gcig bcas/ ༈ yang de rjes sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro bsgom pa'i rim pa mgor/ bla ma dang rdo rje phag mo la phyag 'tshal lo/ /phag mo sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro bsgom pa'i rim pa ni/ zhes dang / mjug tu/ bsngo smon gyi rgyas gdab/ 'di'i byin rlabs bya tshul ni/ zhes dang / mjug gi mchod bstod sogs kyang rigs 'dra'o'i mtha' can/ ༈ yang de rjes don grub ma bsgom pa'i rim pa mgor/ bla ma dang rdo rje phag mo la phyag 'tshal lo/ /don grub ma bsgom pa'i rim pa ni/ zhes dang / mjug tu/ bsngo smon gyis rgyas gdab bo/ /'di'i byin rlabs bya ba'i tshul ni/ zhes dang / mjug tu/ 'dis kyang rje bla ma dbang phyug rab brtan gyi zhabs pad bskal brgyar brtan la 'tsho zhing bzhes par gyur cig maṅga laṃ gyi mtha' can mchan gcig bcas de thams cad ngag dbang chos grags kyis mdzad pa/

༈ glegs bam yongs rdzogs kyi gsham na kho bos brtsams pa'i sbyin bdag gi glegs bam bzhengs tshul tshigs bcad ma smon lam dang bcas pa 'di rnams tshang zhing gong 'og ma 'khrul par bzhugs so/ /yang smras pa/ sa skya'i gser chos phag mo rnam gnyis dang / /dpyal pa'i lugs srol rigs gsum phag mo yi/ /chos skor byin rlabs gzi 'od 'bar ba 'di/ /snod ldan slob ma'i chos kyi skal bar babs/ /bar skabs kyi tshigs bcad do/ /de rnams kyi sgo nas mkha' spyod dbang mo gtso gyur gyi phag mo'i chos skor 'ga' zhig dad ldan sbyin bdag nas glegs bam du bzhengs pa'i dkar chag ma tshang ba med par bstan zin to/ /zhes pa 'di yang gtsang stod grom pa'i stod kyi g.ya' lung gi sa char skyes pa bdag gi yab rje rdo rje 'chang de nyid kyi gsol dpon las 'dzin dang phran rang gi gzim dpon gyi khur 'dzin pa gzhu lung pa bsod nams 'od zer nas 'di skor gyi chos skor yongs su rdzogs pa rnam 'dren rdo rje 'chang 'khor lo sdom pa ngur smrig gar gyi rnam par rol pa drin chen rtsa ba'i bla ma dam pa gnas gsar chos kyi rje wa gind+ra ā nandha su bhā kā ra yā na ba ra shā sa na dhwa dza shrī bha dra'am mtshan gzhan 'jam dbyangs ngag gi dbang phyug rgyal mtshan rab brtan dpal bzang po zhes rtsod pa'i dus kyi mkhas grub yongs kyi dpung gnyen gcig pu rje dam pa de las chos skor yongs su rdzogs par nod pa'i skal ba sbom por gyur pa dang / gzhan yang rdo rje 'chang dngos sbas pa'i rnal 'byor pa chen po blo gsal bstan 'dzin rgya mtsho las 'di skor gyi byin rlabs dang thun mong ba'i 'khrid zhal byung rdzogs rim man ngag be'u bum gyi lung tho re ba zhig nos pa dang / gzhan yang stobs kyi mgon po bi rū pa nyid snyigs ma'i dus 'dir bstan pa skyong ba la bsams bzhin du byon pa thar rtse nam mkha' bsam 'grub mtshan dpe'i rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po ba dang /

rje btsun mkha' spyod dbang mo kun dga' bstan pa'i nyi ma/ kho bo cag bcas par byin rlabs dbang bzhi'i tshul du bskur ba zab mo legs par thob pa dang / gzhan yang tshe rabs sngon ma'i las 'phro'i mthus rje btsun mkha' spyod dbang mo 'di nyid la mi phyed pa'i dad pa thob pa'i rkyen sogs sgo du ma nas rten 'brel rang 'grig lta bus rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i thang sku zhig kyang rtsol ba chen pos bzhengs pa dang / khyad par glegs bam 'di nyid gsar bzhengs skabs/ sgo gsum 'dun pa chig dril gyis lus longs spyod dus gsum dge ba'i dngos po thams cad rnam par dkar ba'i dge ba'i rtsa ba rgya chen po phangs med spungs te bsam pa dag cing sbyor ba gus pa'i sgo nas yongs su rdzogs pa dge tshogs mchod sbyin du bskrun grub pa dang bstun/ ngos la'ang ring mo zhig nas dkar chag gsar rtsom gyi bskul ma btab par brten/ ༈ glegs bam gyi dkar chag 'di yang rje btsun dam pa rdo rje 'chang dang zhal mi gnyis pa mtshan brjod par dka' zhing / don gyi slad du mtshan nas smos na dpal sa skya pa chen po sngags 'chang bla ma thams cad mkhyen pa ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams rin chen bkra shis grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po ba dang / ༈ bcu gsum pa yi bdag por sras bcas rgyal ba kun yang nas yang du bsngags pa thar rtse grub pa'i dbang phyug nam mkha' bsam 'grub kun dga' mtshan dpe'i rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po ba dang / ༈ rje btsun sa bcu'i dbang phyug mañdzu gho ṣa gzhan ngor ngur smrig gar gyi rnam par rol pa snyigs ma'i dus 'dir snyan brgyud bstan pa'i bdag po bdag chen rdo rje 'chang gnyis pa gnas gsar chos kyi rje ngag dbang kun dga' legs pa'i 'byung gnas theg mchog bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po/ ༈ sngon tshe 'phags pa'i yul du paṇa chen shākya shrī gnas brtan sd+ya bi ra sogs mkhas grub dam pa du ma dang /

bod gangs can gyi ljongs 'dir yo ga'i bstan pa'i srog shing bu ston chos kyi rje/ rgyud sde rgya mtsho'i mnga' bdag rdo rje gdan pa kun dga' rnam rgyal/ snyan brgyud bstan pa'i bdag po tshar chen blo gsal rgya mtsho sogs dam pa du ma'i yang srid du zlos gar bsgyur bzhin pa nas/ slar yang snyigs ma'i dus su du ru kha gsum gyis gzir ba'i gnas skabs 'dir rgyal ba gzhan gyi brtse bas lhod pa la bsams bzhin du sku yi skye ba bzhes pa sbas pa'i rnal 'byor pa chen po blo gsal bstan 'dzin rgya mtsho/ ༈ mdo rgyud bstan pa'i sgron me dpal ldan e waṃ pa'i ring lugs bstan pa'i pad tshal mtha' yas mdzad 'phrin gyi 'od snang gis phyogs bcur rgyas par mdzad pa'i nyi 'od dam pa/ 'jam mgon bla ma sangs rgyas ye shes la sogs pa dam pa du ma'i zhabs kyi rdul phran rnyog pa med pa la yan lag mchog gis reg pa/ sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dga' blo gros sangs rgyas bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos rnam byung gi lo/ hor zla dgu pa'i mar ngo'i tshes brgyad mkha' 'gro 'du ba'i dus khyad par can la/ dpal sa skya'i bzhi thog bla brang gi yang steng g.yab ring nyi 'od 'khyil bar legs par sbyar ba'i/ yi ge pa ni bskul ba po bsod nams 'od zer dang / bkra shis rgyal mtshan gnyis nas bgyis pa 'dis kyang gsang chen zab mo slob bshad kyi bstan pa rin po che 'di nyid phyogs bcur dar zhing rgyas la yun ring du gnas par gyur cig/ //i daṃ sha sā na sa satwa hi to bha wantu/ /dge legs 'phel// //maṅga laṃ// // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 2 kun dga' blo gros/ rnal 'byor ma'i be'u bum gyi dkar chag gdams pa'i gnad kun gsal bar byed pa'i nyi 'od PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 1
